
# Introduction

<p class="part-sub">What this volume contains, and why</p>

The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church preserves the broadest biblical canon in all of Christendom:
**81 books**, where the Protestant Bible counts 66 and the Catholic Bible 73. This canon took shape very early —
Christianity has been the official religion of the kingdom of Aksum since the 4th century — and it has preserved,
in the ancient Ge'ez language, scriptures that the rest of the Christian world had lost or set aside.

This volume gathers precisely **what the ordinary 66-book Bible does not contain**. All the common
books (from Genesis to Revelation) are deliberately absent from it: you already have them. Two layers remain:
the treasures unique to the Ethiopian canon, and the deuterocanonical books that Ethiopia shares with the Catholic
and Orthodox Bibles.

## The Texts Unique to the Ethiopian Canon {: .introsub}

**The Book of Enoch** (1 Enoch) — the most famous. Cited by name in the Epistle of Jude
(Jude 14-15), read by the early Christians, it has survived whole only in Ge'ez. Without Ethiopia, it would be lost.
We give the French translation by François Martin and his collaborators (1906), made directly from the Ethiopian text,
completed in an appendix by the account of the wondrous birth of Noah, after the translation published by Migne.

**The Book of Jubilees** — called in Ethiopia *Mäshafä Kufalé*, the "Book of Division."
A rewriting of Genesis and the beginning of Exodus, dictated to Moses on Sinai by "the angel of the Presence,"
which organizes the whole history of the world into jubilees of forty-nine years. It too has survived complete only in Ge'ez.
The Dead Sea Scrolls have confirmed the antiquity and the faithfulness of the text preserved by Ethiopia.

**The Fourth Book of Esdras** — known in Ethiopia as *Ezra Sutuel*. A great apocalypse
written after the destruction of the Temple: seven visions in which Ezra questions the angel Uriel about evil, the justice of God,
and the end of the age. We give the sixteen chapters of the long version; the Ethiopian form corresponds to
chapters 3 to 14 (chapters 1-2 and 15-16 are Latin additions, kept here for the sake of completeness).

**Psalm 151** and **the Prayer of Manasseh** — two short texts preserved by the Ethiopian
psalter and the Ethiopian Chronicles.

## The Deuterocanonical Books {: .introsub}

Part Five gives, in the fine translation of Canon Crampon (1923), the books that the Protestant
Bibles set aside but that Ethiopia reads as Scripture, together with the Catholics and the Orthodox:
**Tobit**, **Judith**, the **Greek additions to Esther**, the **Wisdom of Solomon**,
**Ecclesiasticus** (Sirach), **Baruch** with the Letter of Jeremiah, and the additions to Daniel —
**Susanna**, **Bel and the Dragon**, the **Song of the Three Young Men** in the furnace.

## The Notices {: .introsub}

Some books of the Ethiopian canon have **never been translated into French**: the three books of
**Meqabyan** (the "Ethiopian Maccabees," unrelated to the Greek Maccabees), **Josippon**
(*Zëna Ayhud*, the history of the Jews), and the eight books of the Expanded New Testament
(**Sinodos**, **the Book of the Covenant**, **the Ethiopian Clement**, **the Didascalia**).
Rather than pass over them in silence, Part Six devotes detailed notices to them:
origin, content, place within the canon.

<div class="encadre">

**A word on the status of these books.** The Ethiopian Church reads them as Scripture; other Churches
hold some of them to be deuterocanonical, others apocryphal or pseudepigraphal — ancient Jewish
or Christian writings, precious for understanding the faith of Jesus's time, but outside their canon.
This volume takes no position: it is a library. Here the reader will find texts that
nourished the Epistle of Jude, shed light on the Dead Sea Scrolls, and shaped the faith of millions of Christians
in Ethiopia for sixteen centuries.

</div>

# Part One <SEP> The Book of Enoch

<p class="part-sub">Mäshafä Henok — translation by François Martin and collaborators (1906), from the Ethiopian text</p>

"It was also of these that Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied" (Jude 14). The Book of Enoch
is a collection of five great sections composed between the 3rd and the 1st century before our era:
the **Book of the Watchers** (ch. 1-36: the fall of the angels, Enoch's cosmic journeys),
the **Book of Parables** (ch. 37-71: the "Son of Man" seated on the throne of glory),
the **Book of Astronomy** (ch. 72-82: the solar calendar),
the **Book of Dream Visions** (ch. 83-90: the history of the world in animal allegory),
and the **Epistle of Enoch** (ch. 91-105: exhortations and curses of the last times).
In an appendix, the account of the wondrous birth of Noah.

<p class="footer-note">The numbering follows the Martin edition (105 chapters). The numbers running through the text are the verses.</p>

### Chapter 1 <span class="chap-roman">(I)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Prediction of the Last Judgment.</p>

<p class="v">1. Word of blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect and the righteous who shall be living in the day of affliction, to drive back all the wicked and the ungodly <while the righteous shall be saved>. 2. Enoch then took up his speech and <pronouncing his parable>, said, he, the righteous man whose eyes were opened by the Lord, and who saw the vision of the Holy One who is in the heavens, which the angels showed to me: I have learned all from them, and I have understood, I, what I was seeing; and it is not for this generation, but for the one that is coming, a distant one. 3. It is concerning the elect that I speak, concerning them that I utter a parable: He shall come forth from his dwelling, the Holy and Great One. 4. The God of the world shall go forth from thence upon Mount Sinai, and he shall appear in the midst of his host; and in the strength of his power he shall appear from the height of the heavens. 5. And all shall be in terror, and the watchers shall tremble; fear and a great trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth. 6. The high mountains shall be shaken, and the lofty hills shall be brought low, and they shall melt like wax before the flame. 7. And the earth shall be torn asunder, and all that is upon the earth shall perish, and then shall come a judgment upon all things [and upon all the righteous]. 8. To the righteous he (the Lord) shall give peace, and he shall keep the elect; upon them shall rest mercy; they shall all belong to God, and they shall be happy, and they shall be blessed, and for them shall shine the light of God. 9. And behold, he comes, with myriads of holy ones, to execute judgment upon them, and he shall destroy the ungodly, and he shall punish all flesh for all that the sinners and the ungodly have done and committed against him.</p>

### Chapter 2 <span class="chap-roman">(II)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The order in creation.</p>

<p class="v">1. Consider all the works in heaven: how the luminaries of the heavens do not depart from their course; how they all rise and set, each ordered according to its season, and do not transgress their order. 2. Look at the earth and examine the work that is accomplished upon it, from the beginning to the end, how no work of God changes in its manifestation. 8. See summer and winter, how the whole earth is full of water, and the clouds and the dew and the rain rest upon it.</p>

### Chapter 3 <span class="chap-roman">(III)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The various kinds of trees.</p>

<p class="v">Consider and see all the trees, how they appear; how all their foliage withers and falls, save for fourteen that do not shed their leaves, but wait with their old foliage until the new comes after two or three winters.</p>

### Chapter 4 <span class="chap-roman">(IV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The heat.</p>

<p class="v">And consider again the days of summer, how in its first part (of summer) the sun stands above (the earth); and then you seek shade and shadow because of the heat of the sun; but the earth, too, is scorching by reason of the intensity of the heat, so that you cannot walk upon the earth, nor upon the rock, because of the heat.</p>

### Chapter 5 <span class="chap-roman">(V)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Disorder and the punishment of sinners.</p>

<p class="v">1. Consider how the trees are covered with the greenness of their leaves and bear fruit, understand all this well, and know how he who lives eternally has made all these things for you; 2. and how his work is before him for every year to come, and all his works obey him and do not vary; but everything comes to pass as God has ordained. 8. And see how the seas and the rivers accomplish their work together.</p>

<p class="v">4. But you, you have not persevered; you have not carried out the precept of the Lord, but you have transgressed it, and you have insulted his greatness with the haughty and wounding words of your impure mouth; hard of heart, there shall be no peace for you. 5. Therefore you shall curse your days, and the years of your life shall be lost; but <the years of your perdition> shall be multiplied in an everlasting curse; and there shall be no mercy for you. 6. In those days you shall deliver up your own name to the eternal execration of all the righteous; and they shall curse you forever, you sinners, you altogether with the (other) sinners.</p>

<p class="v">7. And for the elect there shall be light, and joy, and peace, and they shall inherit the earth; but for you, ungodly ones, there shall be a curse. And then wisdom shall be given to the elect; and they shall all live, and they shall sin no more, neither through forgetfulness nor through pride; but the wise shall humble themselves. 9. They shall sin no more, nor be punished all the days of their life, and they shall not die by a punishment or by (divine) wrath; but they shall complete the number of the days of their life, and their life shall advance in peace, and the years of their joy shall be multiplied in an everlasting gladness and peace, all the days of their life.</p>

<p class="v">1st PART</p>

<p class="v">THE FALL OF THE ANGELS AND THE ASSUMPTION OF ENOCH</p>

<p class="v">(Chap. VI-XXXVI)</p>

### Chapter 6 <span class="chap-roman">(VI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The union of the angels with the daughters of men.</p>

<p class="v">1. Now, when the children of men had multiplied, there were born to them in those days beautiful and comely daughters; 2. and the angels, sons of the heavens, saw them, and desired them, and said to one another: "Come, let us choose wives for ourselves from among the children of men, and let us beget children." 3. Then Semyaza, their chief, said to them: "I fear that you may perhaps not wish (truly) to carry out this deed, and that I alone shall be answerable for a great sin." 4. But they all answered him: "Let us all take an oath, and bind ourselves, all of us, one to another with a curse, not to abandon this plan, but to carry it out [this plan] indeed." 5. Then they all swore together and bound themselves thereto, one to another, with a curse. 6. Now they were two hundred in all, and they came down upon Ardis, the summit of Mount Hermon; and they called it "Mount Hermon" because it was upon it that they had sworn and had bound themselves, one to another, with a curse. 7. And here are the names of their chiefs: Semyaza, their prince; Arakib, Aramiel, Kôkabiel, Tamiel, Ramiel, Daniel, Ezeqiel, Baraqiel, Asael, Annaros, Batariel, Ananiel, Zaqilê, Samsapeel, Satariel, Touriel, Yomeyal, Arazeyal. 8. These are their chiefs of ten.</p>

### Chapter 7 <span class="chap-roman">(VII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The birth and misdeeds of the giants.</p>

<p class="v">1. <These,> and all the others with them, took wives; each chose one for himself, and they began to go in unto them and to have intercourse with them, and they taught them charms and incantations, and they taught them the art of cutting roots and (the knowledge) of trees. 2. And these women conceived and brought forth great giants, whose height was three thousand cubits. 3. They devoured all the fruit of the labor of men, until men could no longer sustain them. 4. Then the giants turned against men, to devour them. 5. And they began to sin against the birds and against the beasts, the reptiles and the fish; then they devoured one another's flesh, and drank the blood thereof. 6. Then the earth accused the violent ones.</p>

### Chapter 8 <span class="chap-roman">(VIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">What the evil angels taught men.</p>

<p class="v">1. And Azazel taught men to make swords and blades, the shield and the breastplate, and he showed them metals and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the art of painting the rims of the eyes with antimony and beautifying the eyelids, and the most beautiful and precious stones, and every dye of color, and the revolution of the world. 2. Ungodliness was great and widespread; they committed fornication, and they went astray, and all their ways were corrupted. 8. Amiziras taught the enchanters and the cutters of roots; Armaros taught (them) to break spells, Baraqiel taught the astrologers, Kôkabiel taught the signs, Tamiel (the meaning) of the aspect of the stars, and Asdariel taught the course of the moon. 4. And in (their) undoing men cried out, and their outcry went up to heaven.</p>

### Chapter 9 <span class="chap-roman">(IX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The intervention of the good angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from the height of heaven, and they saw the blood shed in abundance upon the earth, and all the injustice committed upon the earth. 2. And they said to one another: It is the voice of their cry that the desolate earth cries even to the gates of heaven. 3. Now it is to you, holy ones of heaven, that the souls of men make their complaint; they say: Bring our cause before the Most High.</p>

<p class="v">4. And they (the holy ones of heaven) said to the Lord of kings: You are the Lord of lords, the God of gods, and the King of kings, and the throne of your glory abides through all the generations of the world, and your name is holy <and blessed>, and glorious for all eternity [and it is blessed and glorious]. 5. It is you who made all things, and in you resides power over all things; all is uncovered and bare before you; you, you see everything, and there is nothing that can hide itself from you. 6. You have seen what Azazel has done, how he has taught all injustice upon the earth, and revealed the eternal secrets that are wrought in the heavens; 7. <and> in what manner Semyaza, to whom you had given power to rule over his companions, has instructed men. 8. And they went to the daughters of men, upon the earth, and they lay with them, and defiled themselves with these women, and revealed to them every sin. 9. Now these women have brought forth giants, by whom the whole earth has been filled with blood and injustice. 10. And now behold, the souls of those who have died cry out and complain even to the gates of heaven; and their groaning has gone up, and it cannot come forth before the injustice that is committed upon the earth. 11. But you, you know all things before they come to be, and you, you know this, and you tolerate them (the giants), and you do not tell us what we are to do to them for this.</p>

### Chapter 10 <span class="chap-roman">(X)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">God ordains the flood and the punishment of the evil angels by eternal fire; he foretells the happiness of the Righteous.</p>

<p class="v">[1. Then the Most High <spoke>, the Great and Holy One spoke, and he sent Asaryalyor to the son of Lamech: 2. <Go to Noah> and say to him in my name: hide yourself; and reveal to him the end that is coming; for the whole earth is about to perish, a flood of water is about to come upon the whole earth, and whatever is upon it shall perish. 3. And now instruct him, that he may escape, and that his posterity may remain for all generations.]</p>

<p class="v">4. The Lord said further to Raphael: Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness; and open the desert that is in Dudael, and cast him there. 5. Cast upon him rough and jagged stones, cover him with darkness, and let him remain there forever; cover also his face, that he may not see the light. 6. And on the great day of judgment, let him be cast into the furnace of fire. 7. Then heal the earth that the angels have corrupted; and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal (its) wound, and that all the children of men may not perish through all the mystery that the watchers have learned and taught to their children. 8. The whole earth has been corrupted by the knowledge of the work of Azazel; impute to him, therefore, every sin.</p>

<p class="v">9. And the Lord said to Gabriel: Go to the bastards and the reprobates and to the sons of harlots, and make disappear [the sons of harlots and] the children of the watchers from among men; drive them out and send them away; they shall destroy one another by murder, for they shall not have length of days. 10. And whatever they ask of you shall not be (granted) to their fathers on their behalf, for they hope (the children) to live an eternal life, and that each of them (the children) will live five hundred years.</p>

<p class="v">11. And to Michael the Lord said: Go, bind Semyaza and his companions, who have joined themselves with women to defile themselves with them in all their impurity. 12. And when all their children shall have slain one another, and when they themselves shall have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them for seventy generations under the hills of the earth until the day of their judgment and of their consummation, until the eternal judgment be fulfilled. 13. In those days they shall be led away into the abyss of fire, into torments, and they shall be shut up forever in prison. 14. And if anyone is condemned and perishes, he shall henceforth be bound with them until the consummation of the generations of generations. 15. Destroy, therefore, all the voluptuous souls and the children of the watchers, for they have oppressed men.</p>

<p class="v">16. Make all oppression vanish from the face of the earth, let every evil work cease, let the plant of righteousness and truth appear, and it shall be a blessing; works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in joy forever. 17. Then all the righteous shall escape and remain alive until they have begotten a thousand children, and all the days of their youth and of their old age shall be completed in peace. 18. And in those days the whole earth shall be tilled in righteousness; and it shall be entirely planted with trees, and filled with blessing. 19. Upon it shall be planted every tree of delight; vines shall be planted upon it, and the vine that shall be planted there shall yield wine in abundance; and every seed sown upon it shall produce a thousand measures for one, and one measure of olives shall produce ten presses of oil. 20. And you, cleanse the earth from all oppression, from all violence, from all sin, from all ungodliness (sic), and from all impurity that is committed upon the earth; make them vanish from the earth. 21. Let all the children of men become righteous, and let all the peoples venerate me and bless me, and let all worship me. 22. And the earth shall be pure from all corruption, from all sin, from all punishment, and from all sorrow; and I will no longer send (these plagues) upon the earth, unto the generations of generations and unto eternity.</p>

### Chapter 11 <span class="chap-roman">(XI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Divine blessings.</p>

<p class="v">1. And in those days I will open the treasures of blessing that are in heaven, to make them descend upon the earth, upon the works and the labor of the children of men.</p>

<p class="v">2. And peace and truth shall be united all the days of the world and in all the generations of the world.</p>

### Chapter 12 <span class="chap-roman">(XII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The assumption and mission of Enoch to the evil angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. Before these events, Enoch had been hidden away; and there is none among the children of men who knows where he was hidden, and where he is, and what has become of him. 2. Now all his doings (took place) in his days with the watchers and with the holy ones. 3. Now I, Enoch, was occupied in blessing the great Lord, the king of the world, and behold, the watchers called me, Enoch the scribe, and said to me: 4. Enoch, scribe of righteousness, go, make known to the watchers of heaven, who have abandoned the highest heaven, the holy and eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women and have done as the children of men do, and have taken wives, and have corrupted themselves with a great corruption upon the earth: 5. There shall be for them neither peace nor remission of sin. 6. And because they rejoice over their children, they shall see the slaughter of their beloved ones, and over the loss of their children they shall weep and shall entreat forever, but there shall be for them neither mercy nor peace.</p>

### Chapter 13 <span class="chap-roman">(XIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The fallen angels ask Enoch to intercede for them.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then Enoch, going away, said to Azazel: There shall be no peace for you; against you has a great judgment been pronounced, to bind you. 2. There shall be for you neither respite nor intercession, because you have taught injustice, and because of all the works of blasphemy, violence, and sin that you have taught to men. 3. Then, coming forward, I spoke to them all together, and they all trembled, and fear and dread seized them. 4. And they asked me to write for them a form of prayer, that remission might be granted them, and to send the form of their prayer up before the Lord of heaven. 5. For henceforth they can no longer speak (to God), nor lift up their eyes to heaven, for shame of the crime for which they have been condemned. 6. Then I wrote the form of their prayer, and a supplication for their soul, and for each of their works, and for what they were asking, namely, that pardon and respite might be granted them. 7. Then, having withdrawn, I sat down near the waters of Dan, in (the territory of) Dan, which is south-west of Hermon; and I read the form of their prayer until the moment when I fell asleep.</p>

<p class="v">8. And behold, a dream came to me, and visions fell upon me; and I saw visions of punishment, and a voice came which commanded me to speak to the children of heaven and to reprove them. 9. And when I had awakened, I went to them; all together they were sitting weeping in Ublesyael, which lies between Lebanon and Seneser, their faces veiled. 10. And I recounted, in their presence, all the visions I had seen during my sleep, and I began to speak these words of righteousness and to reprove the watchers of heaven.</p>

### Chapter 14 <span class="chap-roman">(XIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The vision of Enoch: the punishment of the evil angels; the dwelling and the throne of God.</p>

<p class="v">1. This book is the word of righteousness and of the correction of the watchers who have existed from eternity, according as the Holy and Great One has ordained in this vision. 2. I myself saw, in my sleep, what I now say, I, with a tongue of flesh and with my breath, which the Great One has given to the mouth of men, that by it they might speak to one another and understand (each other) in their heart. 3. Just as God created man and gave him to understand the word of knowledge, so he created me also, and gave me to reprove the watchers, the children of heaven.</p>

<p class="v">4. I have written your prayer; but in my vision it was shown to me that your prayer would not be granted for all the days of the world, and that judgment is accomplished upon you, and that it (your prayer) shall not be granted. 5. Henceforth you shall no more ascend to heaven for all eternity: it has been ordained that you be bound upon the earth for all the days of the world. 6. But beforehand you shall have seen the slaughter of your beloved children; and you shall not possess them, but they shall fall before you by the sword. 7. And your prayer shall not be (granted) either for them or for you, and you yourselves, while you weep and entreat, you do not utter a single word of the writing that I have written.</p>

<p class="v">8. Now the vision appeared to me thus: behold, clouds called to me in the vision, and a mist called me; and the course of the stars and the lightnings hastened me and desired me; and the winds, in the vision, made me fly, [and made me hasten;] they bore me up on high <and made me enter> into the heavens. 9. I went in until I came near a wall built of hailstones; tongues of fire surrounded it, and they began to frighten me. 10. I entered into the tongues of fire and drew near to a great house, built of hailstones; the walls of that house were like a mosaic of hailstones, and its floor was of hail. 11. Its roof was like the path of the stars and (like) the lightnings; in its midst stood cherubim of fire, and its heaven was of water. 12. A burning fire surrounded the walls, and its door (of the house) blazed with fire. 13. I entered into that house; it was hot as fire and cold as snow; and there was in that house none of the comforts of life; fear overwhelmed me and trembling seized me. 14. Moved and trembling, I fell upon my face and saw a vision. 15. And behold: (there was) another house, greater than the first, all of whose doors stood open before me; it was built of tongues of fire, 16. and altogether so excellent, in magnificence, in splendor, and in greatness, that I cannot tell it to you because of its magnificence and its greatness. 17. Its floor was of fire; lightnings and the course of the stars (formed) its upper part, and its roof, too, was of burning fire. 18. And I looked, and I saw in that house a lofty throne, whose appearance was like crystal, and whose surrounding was like the shining sun, and the voice of the cherubim (was heard). 19. From beneath the throne came forth rivers of burning fire, and I could not look upon them. 20. The great glory sat upon that throne, and his raiment was brighter than the sun and whiter than any snow. 21. Not one angel could enter <into that house> and see the face of the Glorious and Magnificent One, and no being of flesh could look upon him. 22. A burning fire surrounded him, and a great fire stood before him; none of those who surrounded him drew near to him; myriads of myriads (of angels) stood before him, but he sought no counsel. 23. And the holy ones of the holy ones who were near him did not depart by night and were not separated from him. 24. And I, until that moment, was lying upon my face, veiled, trembling, and the Lord, with his own mouth, called me and said to me: Come here, Enoch, and <hear> my [holy] word. 25. <And one of the holy ones, having drawn near to me, awakened me,> made me rise and approach the door; and I looked on, my head bowed down.</p>

### Chapter 15 <span class="chap-roman">(XV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">God charges Enoch to set before the evil angels the enormity of their fault.</p>

<p class="v">1. spoke to me and said, and I heard his voice: "Fear not, Enoch, righteous man, scribe of righteousness; come near here, and hear my voice. 2. And go, say to the watchers of heaven who sent you to entreat for them: It is for you to intercede for men, and not for men to intercede for you. 3. Why have you abandoned the highest and holy heaven, which is eternal, why have you lain with women, why have you defiled yourselves with the daughters of men, why have you taken wives and acted as the children of the earth act, and begotten giants as your sons?</p>

<p class="v">4. You, then, holy, spiritual ones, living an everlasting life, you have defiled yourselves in the blood of women, and you have begotten with the blood of the flesh; according to the blood of men you have desired, and you have made flesh and blood as do those who die and perish. 5. Therefore I gave men women, that they might fructify them, and have children by them, so that all work might not cease upon the earth. 6. But as for you, you were at first spiritual, living an eternal, immortal life, for all the generations of the world. 7. That is why I did not assign you wives, for the dwelling of the spiritual ones of heaven is in heaven.</p>

<p class="v">8. And now the giants who were born of spirits and of flesh shall be called, upon the earth, evil spirits, and their dwelling shall be upon the earth. 9. Evil spirits have come forth from their flesh (of the giants), because they were made by men, <and> from the holy watchers (comes) their origin and their first foundation. They shall be evil spirits upon the earth, and they shall be called evil spirits. [10. The spirits of heaven have their dwelling in heaven; and the spirits of the earth, who were begotten upon the earth, have their dwelling upon the earth. 11. And] the spirits of the giants, of the Nephilim, who oppress, destroy, rush upon, fight, break in pieces upon the earth, and cause mourning there, eat no food and know no thirst, and are undetectable, 12. these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against women, for they came forth <from them>.</p>

### Chapter 16 <span class="chap-roman">(XVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The watchers shall be punished for having communicated to men a baleful secret.</p>

<p class="v">1. From the days of the slaughter, of the destruction, and of the death of the giants — (days) in which the spirits went forth from the souls of their flesh — let those who shall perish be without judgment; thus they shall perish until the day of the fulfillment of the great judgment, when the great age shall come to an end, [because of the watchers and the ungodly]. 2. And now, to the watchers who sent you to entreat for them, who once dwelt in heaven, 3. (say to them:) "You were, but lately, in heaven; but <all> the secrets had not yet been revealed to you; you knew only a futile mystery; in the hardness of your heart you communicated it to women, and, by this mystery, women and men have multiplied evil upon the earth." 4. Say to them, then: "There is no peace for you."</p>

### Chapter 17 <span class="chap-roman">(XVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch is carried away to the abode of the storm, of light, of thunder, and so forth.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then I was carried away to a place whose inhabitants are like a burning fire, and they appear, when they wish, as men. 2. And I was led to the abode of the storm, and to a mountain whose highest summit touched heaven. 3. I saw the dwellings of the luminaries and of the thunder, at the ends, in the abyss where are the bow of fire, the arrows and their quiver, the sword of fire, and all the lightnings. 4. Then I was taken to the waters of life [which are (thus) named], and to the fire of the west; it is this that seizes every setting of the sun. 5. And I came to a river of fire, whose fire flows like water and pours into the great sea that is toward the west. 6. And I saw the great rivers, and I reached a great darkness, and I came to where no being of flesh <does> walk; 7. I saw the mountains of the darkness of winter, and the place where the waters of the whole abyss pour forth. 8. And I saw the mouth of all the rivers of the earth, and the mouth of the abyss.</p>

### Chapter 18 <span class="chap-roman">(XVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="v">Vision of the winds, of seven mountains of precious stones, of an abyss of fire, and of seven stars bound at the ends of heaven and earth.</p>

<p class="v">1. I saw the storehouses of all the winds, and I saw that by them (God) has adorned all creation; and I saw the foundations of the earth. 2. I saw also the cornerstone of the earth, and I saw the four winds that support the earth and the firmament of heaven. 3. I saw how the winds stretch out (like a veil) the height of heaven, and (how) they stand between heaven and earth; they are the pillars of heaven. 4. I saw the winds that turn the sky, that make the disk of the sun set, and all the stars. 5. I saw the winds that, upon the earth, are borne among the clouds; I saw the paths of the angels; I saw, at the ends of the earth, the firmament of the heavens above. 6. Then I passed to the south, <and I saw a place> that burned day and night, where were seven mountains of precious stones, three toward the east, and three toward the south. 7. Now, (among) those that were to the east, one was of many-colored stone, one of pearl, and the other of healing stone; and those that were to the south were of red stone. 8. The one in the middle rose up to heaven like the throne of God; it was of alabaster, and the top of the throne was of sapphire. 9. And I saw a burning fire, and, behind these mountains, 10. [I saw there] a place, beyond the great earth, where the heavens meet.</p>

<p class="v">11. Then I saw a deep chasm, near the pillars of fire of heaven, and I saw between them pillars of fire that descended, whose height and depth were immeasurable. 12. Beyond this chasm, I saw a place over which the firmament of the heavens did not extend, beneath which there was no foundation of the earth; upon it there was neither water nor birds, but this place was desolate and terrible. 13. There I saw seven stars, like great mountains, that were burning, and as I inquired concerning them, 14. the angel said to me: "This place is the end of heaven and of earth; it is the prison of the stars and of the powers of heaven. 15. The stars that roll upon the fire are those that transgressed the commandment of the Lord from their rising, — for they did not come in their time. 16. And he grew angry with them, and bound them until the time of the fulfillment of their sin, in the year of the mystery."</p>

### Chapter 19 <span class="chap-roman">(XIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The fate of the evil angels and of their wives.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then Uriel said to me: "It is here that the angels who united themselves with women shall remain. Their spirits, taking on many appearances, have defiled men, and they will make them go astray, that they may sacrifice to demons as to gods, until the day of the great judgment — the day on which they shall be judged, to be destroyed. 2. As for their wives, who seduced the angels, they shall become Sirens." 3. And I, Enoch, I alone, have seen the vision, the end of all things; and no man shall see as I have seen.</p>

### Chapter 20 <span class="chap-roman">(XX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The names and the offices of the holy angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. Here are the names of the holy angels who watch: 2. Uriel, one of the holy angels, the one over the world and over Tartarus; 3. Raphael, one of the holy angels, the one over the souls of men; 4. Raguel, one of the holy angels, who takes vengeance on the world of the luminaries; 5. Michael, one of the holy angels, set over the best of men, over the keeping of the people; 6. Saraqiel, one of the holy angels, set over the spirits of the children of men who sin against the spirits; 7. Gabriel, one of the holy angels, set over paradise, the dragons, and the cherubim; 8. <Remeiel, one of the holy angels, whom God has set over those who are raised up. Of the archangels, these are the seven names.></p>

### Chapter 21 <span class="chap-roman">(XXI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The fault of the seven stars. — The abyss of fire, prison of the evil angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then I turned to where nothing is made. 2. There I saw a terrible thing; I saw neither heaven above nor earth founded (below), but a formless and frightful place. 3. There I saw seven stars of heaven, bound together in that place, like great mountains, and burning in the fire. 4. Then I asked: "For what sin have they been bound, and why have they been cast here?" 5. Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me: "Enoch, about whom are you asking, and about whom do you inquire and trouble yourself? 6. These stars are of those that transgressed the order of the Lord, and they have been bound here until ten thousand ages be fulfilled, the number of the days of their sins."</p>

<p class="v">7. From there I passed into another place more frightful than that one, and there I saw a horrible thing: there was there a great burning fire, casting out flames; and this place had a fissure going down to the abyss, itself filled with great pillars of fire that were made to descend there; and I could not see either its dimensions or its greatness, and I could not fix my gaze upon it. 8. Then I said: "How horrible and grievous to behold is this place!" 9. Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, spoke to me and said: "Enoch, why do you feel such fear and dread?" — <And I answered:> "It is because of this horrible place, and the appearance of this suffering." 10. He said to me: "This place is the prison of the angels; it is there that they shall be held until eternity."</p>

### Chapter 22 <span class="chap-roman">(XXII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The abode of the souls of the dead before the judgment.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went to another place, and he showed me, to the west, a great and high mountain and hard rocks. 2. There were there four very deep, very wide, and very smooth cavities; <three of them were dark and one bright; in the middle was a spring of water; and I said>: "How smooth and deep and dark in appearance are these cavities!" 8. At that moment, Raphael, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said to me: "These cavities are made so that the spirits of the souls of the dead may be gathered there; it is for this that they were created, that all the souls of the children of men might be gathered there. 4. And these places were made to make them dwell there until the day of their judgment and until the time appointed for them; and this long span (shall last) until the great judgment that shall be rendered upon them."</p>

<p class="v">5. I saw the spirits of the children of men who had died, their voice reaching even to heaven and complaining. 6. Then I asked Raphael, the angel who was with me, and said to him: "Whose is this spirit, whose voice thus reaches to heaven and complains?" 7. He answered me and spoke to me in these terms: "This spirit is the one that came forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain killed, and he accuses him until his line be annihilated from the face of the earth and his line vanish from the race of men."</p>

<p class="v">8. At that moment I inquired [concerning him and] concerning all the (other) cavities: "Why are they separated one from another?"</p>

<p class="v">9. He answered me, saying: "These three were made to separate the (other) spirits of the dead. This one is set apart for the spirits of the righteous, the one where the bright spring of water is. 10. This one was created (to be that) of the sinners when they die and are buried in the earth, and no judgment has been passed on them during their life. 11. There their souls are set apart for this great punishment, until the great day of judgment, of the punishments and torments of the accursed forever, that the retribution of the spirits might take place. There he shall bind them forever. 12. This one was set apart for the souls of those who make entreaty, who make known their undoing, when they were killed in the days of the sinners. 13. And this one was created for the souls of men, of all those who shall not be pure, but sinners, ungodly, and who shall have their portion with the lawless. But their spirits [because those who have been oppressed here below are punished less] shall not be punished on the day of judgment, and shall not be raised up from there."</p>

<p class="v">9. And he answered me and said: "These three cavities were made to separate the spirits of the dead. Thus are separated the souls of the righteous, there where, close by, is found the spring of the water of life, of light. 10. In the same way, a separation was made for the sinners when they die and are buried in the earth, and no judgment has been pronounced against them during their life. 11. It is there that their souls are set apart for this great torment, until the great day of judgment, of the punishment and the torture of those who curse, forever, and until the day of the vengeance that shall be visited upon their souls. It is there that he shall bind them for eternity [or otherwise: before eternity]. 12. And likewise a separation was made for the souls of those who complain, who make known their murder when they were put to death in the days of the sinners. 13. And likewise it was made for the souls of men who were not righteous, but sinners consummate in crime, and they too shall be with the criminals. As for their soul, it shall not be put to death on the day of judgment, but they shall not rise again from there."</p>

<p class="v">14. At that moment I blessed the Lord of glory, and I said: "Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness, who reigns for eternity."</p>
### Chapter 23 <span class="chap-roman">(XXIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The fire that pursues the lights of heaven.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went to another place, toward the west, to the ends of the earth. 2. And I saw a burning fire that ran without resting and without interrupting its course either day or night, while remaining ever the same. 3. And I asked, saying: "What is this (thing), which knows no rest?" 4. Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said: "This (fire) whose course toward the west you have seen is the fire that pursues all the luminaries of heaven."</p>

### Chapter 24 <span class="chap-roman">(XXIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch sees seven splendid mountains and a marvelous tree.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I passed to another place on the earth, and he showed me a mountain of fire that cast up flames day and night. 2. I walked in its direction and I saw seven magnificent mountains, all different one from another, and precious and beautiful stones, and all were splendid, of a magnificent appearance and an admirable aspect: three toward the east leaning one against another, and three toward the south one above another; and (I saw) deep and winding valleys; none approached the other. 3. The seventh mountain was in the midst of them; it surpassed them all like a throne, and fragrant trees surrounded it. 4. Among them was a tree whose fragrance I had never yet smelled, and there was none like it among those trees or any others; it gives off a scent above every perfume, and its leaves, its flowers and its wood never wither; its fruit is beautiful, and it resembles the clusters of the palm tree. 5. Then I said: "The beautiful tree! It is beautiful to see, its foliage is graceful, and its fruit is of a most pleasing appearance." 6. Then Michael, one of the holy and glorious angels, who was with me, and who was set over these (trees), answered me.</p>

### Chapter 25 <span class="chap-roman">(XXV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Michael explains to Enoch the vision of the seven mountains and the marvelous tree.</p>

<p class="v">1. And he said to me: "Enoch, why do you ask me about the fragrance of this tree, and seek to know &lt;the truth&gt;?" 2. Then I answered him, I, Enoch, in these terms: "I desire to be instructed in everything, but especially concerning this tree."</p>

<p class="v">3. And he answered, saying: "This high mountain that you have seen, whose summit resembles the throne of the Lord, it is (precisely) his throne, on which the Holy and great Lord of glory, the eternal King, will sit, when he descends to visit the earth for good. 4. This fragrant tree, no being of flesh has the power to touch until the great judgment, when (God) will take vengeance on all and consummate (all) for eternity; but (then) this tree will be given to the righteous and the humble. 5. By its fruit life shall be imparted to the elect; and it shall be planted on the north side, in a holy place, near the dwelling of the Lord, the eternal King. 6. Then (the righteous and the humble) shall rejoice with gladness, and they shall exult; they shall enter the sanctuary; the sweet fragrance of this tree (shall penetrate) their bones, and they shall live a long life on the earth as your fathers lived, and in their days sorrow, suffering, torments and punishments shall not reach them." 7. Then I blessed the God of glory, the eternal King, because he had prepared such (rewards) for righteous men and had created such things, and had said that they should be given to them.</p>

### Chapter 26 <span class="chap-roman">(XXVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch sees other mountains separated by deep valleys.</p>

<p class="v">1. "From there I went to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed and fertile place &lt;where there were trees&gt; with lasting branches, sprouting even from a tree once cut down. 2. There I saw a holy mountain, and, at the foot of the mountain, water coming from the east and flowing toward the south. 3. Then I saw toward the east another mountain higher than the first, and between them a deep gorge but without width, in which the water flows along the mountain. 4. To the west of this (high mountain) is another mountain, lower and without elevation, and beneath it a gorge, between the two; and another deep and dried-up gorge is found at the end of the three (mountains). 5. And all the gorges are deep and without width, of hard rock; and not a tree &lt;is&gt; planted there. 6. I marveled at the rock, I marveled at the gorge, and I was greatly astonished.</p>

### Chapter 27 <span class="chap-roman">(XXVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Uriel explains to Enoch that the accursed valley (Gehenna) is destined for the accursed.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then I said: "Why is this land blessed and entirely filled with trees, while this gorge in the midst (of the mountains) is accursed?" 2. Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said: "This accursed valley is (destined) for the accursed for eternity; it is there that all those who with their mouth utter unseemly words against the Lord, and speak insolently of his glory, shall be gathered; there they shall be assembled, and there shall be the place of their punishment. 3. At the end of time, there shall appear to them the spectacle of the judgment that shall be carried out in righteousness in the presence of the righteous for eternity; there, every day, those who have obtained mercy shall bless the Lord of glory, the eternal King. 4. On the day of the judgment of these (wicked), (the righteous) shall bless him for the portion he has made for them in (his) mercy." 5. Then I blessed the Lord of glory, I proclaimed his glory and I sang, as befits his greatness.</p>

### Chapter 28 <span class="chap-roman">(XXVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch sees a watercourse.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went toward the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a desert and (it was)</p>

<p class="v">solitary, filled with trees. 2. And from these seeds, water gushed forth from above upon (this desert); 3. it appeared like an abundant watercourse that poured out toward the north-west; and from every side water and dew rose up.</p>

### Chapter 29 <span class="chap-roman">(XXIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The trees of judgment.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went to another point of the desert and I drew near to the east of this mountain. 2. And there I saw the trees of judgment, which give off a sweet odor of incense and myrrh; and their fruits resembled &lt;walnuts&gt;.</p>

### Chapter 30 <span class="chap-roman">(XXX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">New fragrant trees.</p>

<p class="v">1. And I went not far from there, beyond the trees toward the east; and I saw another place: a gorge (filled) with water, like one that never dries up. 2. And I saw a beautiful tree, resembling a fragrant tree, like the resin of the mastic tree. 3. On the banks of these gorges I saw the fragrant cinnamon tree, then I went on further toward the east.</p>

### Chapter 31 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The nectar; the fruit of the aloe.</p>

<p class="v">1. And I saw other mountains on which there were trees, and from them there flowed a kind of nectar called Sararâ and Galbaniun. 2. Behind these mountains, I saw another mountain on which there were aloes, and these trees were filled with a (fruit) resembling almonds, and hard. 3. And when this fruit is crushed, it surpasses every perfume.</p>

### Chapter 32 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The earthly paradise and the tree of knowledge.</p>

<p class="v">1. After (having smelled) these perfumes, as I looked toward the north, beyond the mountains, I saw seven mountains filled with pure nard, fragrant trees, cinnamon and pepper. 2. From there I crossed the summit of these mountains, far off toward the east, and I crossed the Erythraean Sea and moved away from it, and I passed above the angel Zotiel (sic). 3. And I arrived in the paradise of righteousness, and I saw beyond (?) those trees, many great trees; they grow there of themselves, and their fragrance is sweet; they are tall, of great beauty, and magnificent; and there is (there) the tree of wisdom: those who eat of it possess great wisdom. 4. It resembles the carob tree; its fruit, resembling a cluster of grapes, is very beautiful; and the fragrance of this tree spreads and penetrates far off. 5. And I said: "How beautiful is this tree, and how [beautiful and] pleasant is its appearance!" 6. The holy angel Raphael, who was with me, answered me and said: "This is the tree of wisdom, of which your old father and your old mother, your ancestors, ate; and they knew knowledge, their eyes were opened, they knew that they were naked, and they were driven out of paradise."</p>

### Chapter 33 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The ends of the earth and the gates by which the stars rise.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went to the ends of the earth, and there I saw great beasts, different one from another, and also birds different in appearance, in beauty, and in song; each differed from the other. 2. To the east of these beasts, I saw the ends of the earth where heaven rests, and the gates of heaven were open. 3. And I saw how the stars of heaven rise, and I counted the gates by which they rise, and I wrote down all their risings, for each one in particular, according to their number and their names, according to their conjunction and their position, their time and their months, as Uriel, the angel who was with me, showed me. 4. He showed me and he wrote everything for me; he also wrote for me their names, their laws and their groupings.</p>

### Chapter 34 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The gates and the winds of the north.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went toward the north, to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and magnificent arrangement at the confines of all the earth. 2. There I saw three gates of heaven open in the sky; from each of them come out the winds of the north; when they blow, it is with cold, hail, frost, snow, dew and rain. 3. Through one gate, they blow for good; but when they blow through the other two gates, it is with violence and desolation upon the earth, and it is with force that they blow.</p>

### Chapter 35 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The gates and outlets of the west.</p>

<p class="v">From there I went toward the west, to the ends of the earth, and I saw there three gates of heaven open, as I had seen in the east: as many gates and as many outlets.</p>

### Chapter 36 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The gates of the south and of the east.</p>

<p class="v">1. From there I went toward the south, to the ends of the earth, and there I saw three gates of heaven open, from which come out the south wind, the dew, the rain [and the wind]. 2. And from there I went toward the east, to the ends of heaven, and there I saw three gates of heaven open toward the east, and above them small gates. 3. Through each of these small gates pass the stars of heaven, and they go to the west by the path that has been traced for them. 4. Beholding (this spectacle), I have blessed at all times the Lord of glory; and I will continue to bless him, who has accomplished great and magnificent wonders to show the greatness of his work to his angels, to the spirits and to men, that they may praise his work, his entire creation; that they may behold the work of his power, that they may praise the grand work of his hands, and that they may bless him throughout all eternity.</p>

<p class="v">PART TWO</p>

<p class="v">THE BOOK OF PARABLES</p>

<p class="v">(Chap. XXXVII-LXXI)</p>

<p class="v">______</p>

### Chapter 37 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch's second vision: three parables are revealed to him.</p>

<p class="v">1. The second vision that he saw; the vision of wisdom that Enoch saw, son of Jared, son of Mahalalel, son of Cainan, son of Enos, son of Seth, son of Adam. 2. And here is the beginning of the word of wisdom that I have uttered to say to those who dwell on the dry land: "Hear, O ancients, and see, men of the future, the holy word that I am about to speak in the presence of the Lord of spirits. 3. It would be better to say it to the ancients; but even to the men of the future, we shall not refuse the beginning of wisdom. 4. Until now, there has certainly not been given, by the Lord of spirits, wisdom (comparable to that) which I have received, according to my understanding, according to the good pleasure of the Lord of spirits, by whom was given to me the portion of eternal life. 5. Now three parables have been (communicated) to me, and I lifted up (my voice), saying to those who dwell on the dry land:</p>

### Chapter 38 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">First parable: the woeful fate of sinners on the day of judgment.</p>

<p class="v">1. First parable. When the assembly of the righteous shall appear, and sinners shall be judged for their sins, and they shall be driven from the face of the dry land; 2. and when righteousness shall be made manifest before the face of the righteous elect, whose work depends upon the Lord of spirits; and when light shall appear to the righteous and to the elect who dwell on the dry land, where shall be the dwelling of sinners, where shall be the resting place of those who have denied the Lord of spirits? It would have been better for them that they had not been born. 3. When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed, (then) sinners shall be judged, and the impious shall be driven from the face of the righteous and the elect. 4. From then on they shall be neither strong nor exalted, those who possess the earth, and they shall not be able to look upon the face of the saints, for it is the light of the Lord of spirits that has appeared upon the face of the saints, of the righteous and of the elect. 5. The kings and the mighty, in that time, shall perish and shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous and the saints. 6. And from then on no one shall ask mercy for them from the Lord of spirits, for their life shall have been consumed.</p>

### Chapter 39 <span class="chap-roman">(XXXIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The abode of the righteous and of the Elect One of righteousness.</p>

<p class="v">1. [In those days, the children of the elect and of the saints shall come down from the height of heaven, and their race shall be one with the children of men. 2. And in those days, Enoch received books of indignation and of wrath, and books of trembling and of commotion.] And there shall be no mercy for them, says the Lord of spirits. 3. At that time, a whirlwind of wind snatched me from the face of the earth and set me down at the end of the heavens. 4. And there I saw another vision: the dwellings of the saints, and the resting places of the righteous. 5. There my eyes saw their dwellings in the midst of the angels of his righteousness, and their resting places in the midst of the saints; they ask, they intercede and they pray for the children of men; and righteousness flows like water before them, and mercy, like dew upon the earth; thus shall it be among them, unto the ages of ages.</p>

<p class="v">6. And in that place, my eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faithfulness; and righteousness reigns in his days, and the righteous and the elect are innumerable before him, unto the ages of ages. 7. I saw his dwelling under the wings of the Lord of spirits; all the righteous and the elect shine before him like the brightness of fire; their mouth is filled with blessing, and their lips glorify the name of the Lord of spirits; and righteousness before him does not pass away, and truth does not pass away before him. 8. It is there that I wished to dwell, and my soul longed for that abode; it is there that my portion was from the first, for thus it has been decreed for me before the Lord of spirits.</p>

<p class="v">9. In those days, I praised and I exalted the name of the Lord of spirits, with blessing and praise, for he had confirmed me in blessing and in glory, according to the good pleasure of the Lord of spirits. 10. And for a long time my eyes gazed upon that place, and I blessed it and I glorified it, saying: Blessed is he, and blessed be he from the beginning even unto eternity. 11. And before him there is no end; before the world was created, he knows what he is, as well as what shall come to pass from generation to generation. 12. They bless you, those who do not sleep; they stand before your glory, and they bless, they glorify and they exalt, saying: Holy, Holy, Holy, the Lord of spirits; he fills the earth with spirits. 13. And there my eyes saw all those who do not sleep, standing before him and blessing (him) and saying: "Blessed art thou; and blessed be the name of the Lord unto the ages of ages!" 14. And my face was transformed, so that I could no longer look.</p>

### Chapter 40 <span class="chap-roman">(XL)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The four archangels: Michael, Raphael, Gabriel and Phanuel.</p>

<p class="v">1. And after this, I saw thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads, innumerable and beyond (all) reckoning, who stand before the Lord of spirits. 2. Then I looked and I saw, on the four sides of the Lord of spirits, four different faces of those who do not sleep, and I learned their names, which the angel who walked with me made known to me and who showed me all the secrets. 3. And I heard the voices of these four faces, as they sang praises in the presence of the Lord of glory. 4. The first voice blesses the Lord of spirits unto the ages of ages. 5. And I heard the second voice bless the Elect One and the elect who depend on the Lord of spirits. 6. And I heard the third voice ask and pray for those who dwell on the dry land; and it entreated in the name of the Lord of spirits. 7. And I heard the fourth voice drive away the Satans, and it did not permit them to come near the Lord of spirits to accuse those who dwell on the dry land.</p>

<p class="v">8. After this, I asked the angel of peace who walked with me and showed me everything that is hidden: "Who are these four faces, whom I have seen and whose word I have heard and written?" 9. And he said to me: "The first is the merciful and very patient Michael; the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael; the third, who is set over all strength, is Gabriel; and the fourth, who presides over repentance, for the hope of those who shall inherit eternal life, his name is Phanuel." 10. These are the four angels of the Lord of spirits, and the four voices that I heard in those days.</p>

### Chapter 41 <span class="chap-roman">(XLI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The abode of the elect. — The secrets of the elements, of the sun and of the moon.</p>

<p class="v">"Then I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom shall be divided, and how the deeds of men shall be weighed in the balance. 2. There, I saw the abode of the elect and the abode of the saints, and my eyes saw there all the sinners, who deny the name of the Lord of spirits, driven from that place, led away captive, and no longer able to subsist because of the punishment that comes from the Lord of spirits.</p>

<p class="v">[3. And there my eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds — how they are distributed to blow upon the earth — and the secrets of the clouds and of the dew; and there I saw whence they come forth, in that very place, and whence the dust of the earth is saturated (with moisture). 4. There I saw closed storehouses, from which the winds are distributed; the storehouse of hail and of wind, the storehouse of mist and of clouds — and its cloud (from that storehouse) hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world. 5. I saw the storehouses of the sun and of the moon, whence (these luminaries) come forth, and whither they return — and their return is glorious — and how the one is more beautiful than the other — and (how) their course is magnificent; (and I saw) how they do not depart from their path, and they neither add nor take away anything from their course, but remain faithful to one another, in the oath they have sworn to each other. 6. The sun comes forth first, and it follows its way by the command of the Lord of spirits; and his name shall remain unto the ages of ages. 7. Then comes the hidden and then revealed path of the moon; she accomplishes the course of her way in that same place, during the day and during the night; and the one is opposite the other in the presence of the Lord of spirits; and they give thanks and they praise without resting, for to them the giving of thanks is a rest. 8. The sun indeed accomplishes numerous revolutions, whether to bless or to curse; and the course of the path of the moon is light for the righteous, and darkness for sinners, in the name of the Lord who has separated light from darkness, who has divided the spirits of men, and has strengthened the spirits of the righteous in the name of his righteousness.]</p>

<p class="v">9. For no angel stops them (the sinners of v. 2); and (no) power can restrain them, for the judge sees them all, and he judges them all before him (God).</p>

### Chapter 42 <span class="chap-roman">(XLII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The abode of wisdom and that of injustice.</p>

<p class="v">1. Wisdom found no place where she might dwell, so her dwelling is in the heavens. 2. Wisdom went forth to dwell among the children of men, and she found no habitation; wisdom returned to her abode and settled in the midst of the angels. 3. And injustice went forth from her lairs; she found those whom she was not seeking and she dwelt among them, like rain in the desert, and like dew upon a parched land.</p>

### Chapter 43 <span class="chap-roman">(XLIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The revolutions of the stars; their symbolic meaning.</p>

<p class="v">[1. Then I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how he calls them by their names; and (how) they listen to him. 2. And I saw the balance of righteousness, how</p>

<p class="v">they are weighed (there) according to their light, according to the breadth of their spaces and the day of their appearing; their revolution engenders the lightning; and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with one another. 3. I asked the angel who walked with me, who showed me what is hidden: "Who are these?" 4. And he said to me: "The Lord of spirits has shown you their parable: these are the names of the saints who dwell on the dry land and believe in the name of the Lord of spirits unto the ages of ages."</p>

### Chapter 44 <span class="chap-roman">(XLIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The stars that transform into lightnings.</p>

<p class="v">I saw yet other things concerning the lightnings, how certain stars arise, become lightnings, and can no longer abandon their (new) form.]</p>

### Chapter 45 <span class="chap-roman">(XLV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Second parable: the fate of the renegades; the transformation of the heavens and of the earth.</p>

<p class="v">1. Here is the second parable concerning those who deny the name of the abode of the saints, as well as the Lord of spirits. 2. They shall not ascend to heaven and they shall not reach the earth: such shall be the lot of the sinners who have denied the name of the Lord of spirits, and who, thus, are reserved for the day of affliction and of misfortune. 3. On that day my Elect One shall sit on a throne of glory, and he shall choose among their deeds (the deeds of men), and their resting places shall be innumerable; and their soul shall be strengthened within them, when they see my elect and those who have had recourse to my glorious name.</p>

<p class="v">4. On that day, I will make my Elect One dwell in their midst, and I will transform heaven, and I will make it a blessing and a light for eternity. 5. And I will transform the dry land and I will make it a blessing; and I will make my elect dwell there; but those who have committed sin and crime shall not tread upon it. 6. For I have seen and I have filled my righteous ones with peace, and I have made them dwell before me; but the judgment of sinners has drawn near to me so that I may make them disappear from the face of the earth.</p>

### Chapter 46 <span class="chap-roman">(XLVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The "Head of Days" and the Son of Man.</p>

<p class="v">1. There I saw someone who had a "head of days," and his head was like white wool; and with him another whose face had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of grace, like one of the holy angels. 2. I asked the angel who walked with me, and who made known to me all the secrets concerning this Son of Man: "Who is he, and whence does he come; why does he walk with the Head of Days?"</p>

<p class="v">3. "He answered me and said: "This is the Son of Man, who possesses righteousness and with whom righteousness dwells, who shall reveal all the treasures of the secrets, because the Lord of spirits has chosen him, and his lot has prevailed by right before the Lord of spirits for eternity. 4. The Son of Man whom you have seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their couches, and the strong from their seats; and he shall break the reins of the strong, and he shall shatter the teeth of sinners; 5. and he shall overthrow the kings from their thrones and their power, because they have not exalted him and have not glorified him and have not humbly confessed whence the kingship had been given to them. 6. He shall overthrow the face of the strong, and he shall fill them with shame; darkness shall be their dwelling and worms shall be their couch, and they shall not be able to hope to rise from their couch, because they have not exalted the name of the Lord of spirits. 7. These are they who judge the stars of heaven and who raise their hands against the Most High, who tread the dry land and dwell upon it, and whose every work manifests injustice [and all their works are injustice]; their power resides in their riches, and their trust (goes) to the gods that they have made with their own hands; they deny the name of the Lord of spirits; 8. and they persecute his assemblies, and the faithful who are attached to the name of the Lord of spirits."</p>

### Chapter 47 <span class="chap-roman">(XLVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The blood of the righteous cries out for vengeance. Joy of the saints at the approach of this vengeance.</p>

<p class="v">1. And in those days the prayer of the righteous and the blood of the righteous one shall rise from the earth before the Lord of spirits. 2. In those days, the saints who dwell in the heights of the heavens shall unite in a single voice, and they shall entreat, pray, glorify, give thanks and bless the name of the Lord of spirits on account of the blood of the righteous that has been shed, and of the prayer of the righteous, that it may not be vain before the Lord of spirits, but that justice may be done to them, and that their waiting may not be eternal.</p>

<p class="v">3. "At that time, I saw the "Head of Days," while he sat on the throne of his glory, and the books of the living were opened before him, and all his host, which dwells in the heights of the heavens, and his court stood in his presence. 4. And the heart of the saints was filled with joy because the number of righteousness draws near (to its appointed end), the prayer of the righteous has been heard, and the blood of the righteous one has been avenged before the Lord of spirits.</p>

### Chapter 48 <span class="chap-roman">(XLVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The fountain of righteousness. — The Son of Man, light and hope of the peoples. — Punishment of the kings and the mighty.</p>

<p class="v">1. In that place I saw the fountain of righteousness, which is inexhaustible; and all around it there were many fountains of wisdom; and all the thirsty drank of it and were filled with wisdom, and they had their dwellings with the righteous, the saints and the elect.</p>

<p class="v">2. And at that moment, this Son of Man was named before the Lord of spirits, and his name (was named) before the "Head of Days." 3. And before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of heaven were made, his name was named before the Lord of spirits. 4. He shall be a staff for the righteous, that they may lean upon him and not fall; he shall be the light of the peoples, and he shall be the hope of those who suffer in their heart. 5. All those who dwell on the dry land shall fall down and worship him; and they shall bless and they shall glorify and they shall sing to the Lord of spirits. 6. And it is for this that he has been chosen and hidden before him (the Lord) before the creation of the world, and for eternity... 7. The wisdom of the Lord of spirits has revealed him to the saints and to the righteous, for he has preserved the portion of the righteous because they have hated and despised this world of injustice and have hated all its work and its ways in the name of the Lord of spirits; for it is by his name that they shall be saved, and he is the avenger of their life.</p>

<p class="v">8. In those days the kings of the earth and the mighty who possess the dry land shall have their faces cast down because of the work of their hands, for on the day of their anguish and their affliction, they shall not save themselves. 9. I will deliver them into the hands of my elect; as straw in the fire and as lead in the water, so shall they burn before the face of the saints, and they shall be submerged before the face of the righteous; no trace of them shall be found any more. 10. And on the day of their affliction, there shall be rest upon the earth; before them (the righteous) they shall fall and shall rise no more, and there shall be no one to stretch out a hand to them and raise them up, because they have denied the Lord of spirits and his Messiah. Blessed be the name of the Lord of spirits!</p>

### Chapter 49 <span class="chap-roman">(XLIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Power and wisdom of the Elect One.</p>

<p class="v">1. For before him wisdom flows like water and glory does not pass away unto the ages of ages. 2. Because he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, injustice shall vanish like a shadow and shall have no refuge; for the Elect One stands before the Lord of spirits, and his glory (abides) unto the ages of ages, and his power unto the generations of generations. 3. In him dwells the spirit of wisdom, and the spirit that gives understanding, and the spirit of knowledge and of strength, and the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness. 4. It is he who judges the secret things, and no one can utter vain words before him, for he is the Elect One in the presence of the Lord of spirits according to his good pleasure.</p>

### Chapter 50 <span class="chap-roman">(L)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Glory of the righteous and woe of sinners on the day of the Elect One.</p>

<p class="v">1. In those days there shall be a change for the saints and for the elect: the light of days shall dwell upon them, and glory and honor shall come to the saints. 2. On the day of affliction, when misfortune shall be heaped upon sinners, the righteous shall be victorious by the name of the Lord of spirits, and he shall show the others how to do penance and to renounce the work of their hands. 3. They shall have no honor by the name of the Lord of spirits, but by his name they shall be saved, and the Lord of spirits shall have pity on them, for his mercy is great. 4. But he is just in his judgment; and in the presence of his glory, in his judgment, injustice shall not be able to stand: whoever does not do penance before him shall perish. 5. And from now on I will show them mercy no more, says the Lord of spirits.</p>

### Chapter 51 <span class="chap-roman">(LI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The Elect One shall choose the righteous from among the dead whom the earth and Sheol shall give back. These righteous shall dwell upon the earth.</p>

<p class="v">1. In those days, the earth shall give back its deposit, and Sheol shall give back what it has received, and the netherworlds shall give back what they owe. 2. He (the Elect One) shall choose from among them the righteous and the saints, for the day when they shall be saved draws near. 3. The Elect One, in those days, shall sit upon my throne, and all the secrets of wisdom shall come forth from the utterances of his mouth, for the Lord of spirits has endowed him with this gift and has glorified him. 4. In those days the mountains shall leap like rams, and the hills shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk; and they shall all (the righteous) become angels in heaven. 5. Their faces shall shine with joy, because, in those days, the Elect One shall arise; and the earth shall rejoice, and the righteous shall dwell in it, and the elect shall walk and stroll upon it.</p>

### Chapter 52 <span class="chap-roman">(LII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The mountains of metal shall melt before the Elect One.</p>

<p class="v">1. After these days, in that place where I had seen all the visions of what is hidden — for I had been carried away by a whirlwind of wind, and taken toward the west — 2. there indeed my eyes saw all the secrets of the heavens that are to come, a mountain of iron, a mountain of copper, a mountain of silver, a mountain of gold, a mountain of tin and a mountain of lead. 3. And I asked the angel who walked with me, saying: "What are these things that I have seen in the secret?"</p>

<p class="v">4. "He said to me: "All that you have seen shall serve the power of his Messiah, that he may be strong and mighty upon the earth." 5. Then this angel of peace, taking up the word, said to me: "Wait a little, and there shall be revealed to you all the mysteries that surround the Lord of spirits. 6. These mountains that your eyes have seen, the mountain of iron, the mountain of copper, the mountain of silver, the mountain of gold, the mountain of tin and the mountain of lead, they shall all be before the Elect One like wax before the fire and like water that falls from above upon these mountains, and they shall soften at his feet. 7. And in those days, one shall be saved neither by gold nor by silver, and one shall not be able to flee. 8. There shall be neither iron for war, nor cloth for the breastplate; bronze shall be useless, tin shall serve for nothing and shall not be esteemed, and lead shall not be sought after. 9. All these things shall be destroyed and annihilated on the face of the earth, when the Elect One shall appear before the face of the Lord of spirits."</p>

### Chapter 53 <span class="chap-roman">(LIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The bottomless valley. — The angels of punishment prepare the instruments of Satan. — The house of assembly of the Elect One.</p>

<p class="v">1. And there my eyes saw a deep valley with wide mouths; and all those who dwell on the dry land, the sea and the islands, bring it presents, gifts and offerings, but this deep valley is not filled. 2. Their hands commit crime, and all that (the righteous) produce with toil the sinners devour criminally; so the sinners shall perish before the face of the Lord of spirits, and from the face of his earth. They shall be driven away ceaselessly unto the ages of ages.</p>

<p class="v">3. For I saw all the angels of punishment establishing themselves and preparing all the instruments of Satan. 4. And I asked the angel of peace who walked with me: "These instruments, for whom are they preparing them? 5. And he said to me: "These (instruments), they are preparing them for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that by them they may perish.</p>

<p class="v">6. "After this, the Righteous One and the Elect One shall cause the house of his assembly to appear; from then on (the righteous) shall no longer (be) driven from it, thanks to the name of the Lord of spirits. 7. These mountains shall no longer be in the presence of his righteousness, like the earth; and the hills shall become like a fountain of water, and the righteous shall rest from the oppression of sinners."</p>

### Chapter 54 <span class="chap-roman">(LIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The valley of fire. — The instruments of torment of the wicked angels. — The scourge of God (the flood).</p>

<p class="v">1. And I looked, and I turned toward another side of the earth, and I saw there a deep valley where a fire was blazing. 2. And they brought the kings and the mighty and cast them into this deep valley.</p>

<p class="v">3. There my eyes saw their instruments of torment being forged, chains of iron that could not be weighed. 4. And I asked the angel of peace who walked with me, saying: "These chains of torture, for whom are they prepared?" 5. He said to me: "These chains are prepared for the hosts of Azazel, in order to seize them and cast them into the abyss of utter damnation, and to cover their jaws with rough stones, as the Lord of spirits has commanded. 6. Then Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel shall seize them on that great day, and shall cast them, on that day, into the burning furnace, that the Lord of spirits may punish them for their iniquity, for they have made themselves the servants of Satan, and have led into sin those who dwell on the dry land.</p>

<p class="v">7.
