"In those days shall come the scourge of the Lord of spirits, and (this scourge) shall open all the reservoirs of the waters that are above the heavens, and the fountains that are [beneath the heavens and] beneath the earth. 8. All these waters shall mingle, waters with waters; the water that is above the heaven is of the male sex, and the water that is beneath the earth is of the female sex. 9. And all those who dwell on the dry land, and those who dwell beneath the ends of heaven, shall be annihilated. 10. Therefore they shall acknowledge the injustice that they have committed upon the earth, and by it they shall perish."</p>

### Chapter 55 <span class="chap-roman">(LV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Oath of the "Head of Days." — The rainbow set as a sign in the heavens.</p>

<p class="v">1. After this, the "Head of Days" repented and said: "It is in vain that I have destroyed all those who dwell on the dry land." 2. And he swore by his great name: "From now on I will no longer act thus toward all those who dwell on the dry land; I will place a sign in the heavens, and it shall be a pledge of faithfulness between me and them forever, as long as heaven shall be above the earth.]</p>

<p class="v">3. "And here is what shall come to pass according to my order: If I wish to seize them by the hand of the angels, on the day of tribulation and of suffering, beforehand I will let my wrath and my punishment rest upon them, (yes) my wrath and my punishment, says God, the Lord of spirits. 4. Mighty kings who dwell on the dry land, you shall see my Elect One sit upon the throne of glory and judge Azazel and all his companions and all his host, in the name of the Lord of spirits."</p>

### Chapter 56 <span class="chap-roman">(LVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="v">The angels of punishment shall cast their elect into the crevasse of the valley. — March of the kings of the Parthians and the Medes against the land of God's elect. — Their annihilation in Sheol.</p>

<p class="v">1. I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment, who marched holding whips and chains of iron and bronze. 2. And I asked the angel of peace who walked with me, saying: "To whom are those going who hold the whips?" 3. He said to me: "To their elect and their beloved, that these may be cast into the deep crevasse of the valley. 4. Then this valley shall be filled with their elect and (their) beloved, the time of their life shall be consumed, and the time of their wandering shall no longer be counted.</p>

<p class="v">5. "In those days, the angels shall return and shall cast themselves toward the east, among the Parthians and the Medes; they shall stir up the kings, and a spirit of trouble shall invade them (the kings); and they shall overthrow them from their thrones, and (these kings) shall flee like lions from their dens and like famished hyenas in the midst of their flocks. 6. And they shall go up and they shall trample the land of his elect (of God), and the land of his elect shall be before them a threshing floor and a beaten path. 7. But the city of my righteous ones shall be an obstacle for their horses, and they shall kindle war among themselves, and their right hand shall deploy its strength against them; — man shall not know his brother, nor the son his father and his mother, until the number of corpses is (complete) as a result of their death, and their punishment is not in vain. 8. At that time, Sheol shall open its mouth, they shall be swallowed up in it and their destruction shall come to an end; Sheol shall devour the sinners before the face of the elect."</p>
### Chapter 57 <span class="chap-roman">(LVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Chariots mounted by men and borne upon the winds cross the sky.</p>

<p class="v">1. And it came to pass, after this, that I saw another army of chariots, upon which men were mounted; and they went, upon the winds, from the east and from the west even to the south. 2. The rumbling of their chariots was heard, and when this tumult arose, the saints perceived it from heaven, the pillar of the earth was shaken from its base, and it was heard from one end of heaven to the other for the space of a day. 3. And they all (the saints) prostrated themselves and worshipped the Lord of spirits. Such is the end of the second parable.</p>

### Chapter 58 <span class="chap-roman">(LVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Third parable on the happiness of the saints.</p>

<p class="v">1. And I began to speak the third parable concerning the righteous and the elect. 2. Blessed are you, O righteous and elect, for your portion is glorious. 3. The righteous shall be in the light of the sun, and the elect in the light of eternal life; and the days of their life shall be without end, the days of the saints shall be without number. 4. They shall seek the light and they shall find righteousness with the Lord of spirits; peace to the righteous in the name of the Lord of the world! 5. After this it shall be said to the saints in heaven to seek the secrets of righteousness, the portion of faith, for it shines like the sun upon the dry ground, and the darkness has vanished. 6. And there shall be a light that cannot be measured, and they shall not enter into a (limited) number of days, for beforehand the darkness shall have been dispelled, the light shall have been made firm before the Lord of spirits, and the light of truth shall have been made firm for ever before the Lord of spirits.</p>

### Chapter 59 <span class="chap-roman">(LIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The lightnings, the luminaries, and the thunder.</p>

<p class="v">[1. At that time, my eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings and of the luminaries, and their judgment (the judgment that they execute): they shine to bless or to curse according to the good pleasure of the Lord of spirits. 2. There I saw the secrets of the thunder, when it strikes at the height of heaven and its voice is heard, [and he showed me the dwellings of the dry ground,] and the voice of the thunder is (a voice) of peace and of blessing or of cursing, according to the order of the Lord of spirits. 3. And after this, all the secrets of the luminaries and of the lightnings were shown to me; they shine to bless and to satisfy.]</p>

### Chapter 60 <span class="chap-roman">(LX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The agitation of heaven. — Behemoth and Leviathan. The elements</p>

<p class="v">[1. In the year five hundred, in the seventh month, the fourteenth day of the month, in the life of Noah, in this parable, I saw that the heaven of heavens was shaken with a great shaking, and the host of the Most High, and the angels, by thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads, were stirred with a great agitation. 2. "The Head of Days" sat upon the seat of his glory, and the angels and the righteous stood round about him.</p>

<p class="v">3. And as for me, a great trembling seized me, fear took hold of me, my loins gave way, my loins melted, and I fell upon my face. 4. But Michael sent another angel from among the saints; he raised me up, and when he had raised me up, my spirit returned, for I could not bear the sight of this host and of its agitation and of the shakings of heaven.</p>

<p class="v">5. And Michael said to me: Why does the vision of these things trouble you? Until this day has been the time of his mercy (God's), and he has been merciful and slow to anger toward those who dwell upon the dry ground. 6. But when the day, and the power, and the chastisement, and the judgment shall come, which the Lord of spirits has prepared for those who do not worship the judgment of righteousness, for those who deny the judgment of righteousness and for those who take his name in vain, and that day has been prepared as a covenant for the elect but as an inquisition for sinners, (then he will kill the little ones with their mother and the children with their father).</p>

<p class="v">7. Now two monsters were separated on that day: a female monster named Leviathan, that she might dwell in the abyss of the seas, above the springs of the waters; 8. and a male named Behemoth, who occupies with his breast the immense desert named Dendaïn, to the east of the garden where the elect and the righteous dwell, where he (God) received my grandfather, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom the Lord of spirits made.</p>

<p class="v">9. And I questioned another angel, that he might show me the strength of these monsters, how they had been separated in a single day, and cast, the one into the abyss of the sea, and the other into the land of the desert.</p>

<p class="v">10. He said to me: "You, son of man, here you have come to know what is secret. . ."</p>

<p class="v">11. And another angel spoke to me, who walked with me and who showed me what is hidden, the beginning and the end, in heaven above, and beneath the dry ground in the abyss, and at the ends of heaven, and in the foundations of heaven; 12. and the storehouses of the winds, how the winds are divided, how they are weighed, and how the springs of the winds are divided and counted according to the strength of the wind; and the power of the light of the moon, and how it is a power of righteousness; and the divisions of the stars according to their name, and every division that is made (among the stars); 13. and the thunder in the places where it falls, and every division that is made among the lightnings, that they may shine, and (among?) their host, that they may obey promptly. 14. For the thunder has pauses to hold back its voice (as) it has been given to it, and the thunder and the lightning are not separated in anything; by the spirit they both proceed, and they are not separated. 15. For when the lightning shines, the thunder gives forth its voice, and the spirit at once calms it and divides equally between them, for the storehouse of their times is of sand, and each of them is held back by a bridle, and it is drawn back by the power of the spirit, and it is thus led according to the multitude of the regions of the earth. 16. The spirit of the sea is male and vigorous, and, according to the strength of its vigor, it draws it back with a bridle, and thus it is driven and scattered over all the mountains of the earth. 17. The spirit of the frost is its own angel, and the spirit of the hail is a good angel. 18. The spirit of the snow lets it fall by its own strength; it has a special spirit, that which rises from it is like smoke, and its name is coolness. 19. The spirit of the mist is not associated with them in their storehouses, but it has a storehouse of its own, for its own path is bright (?) in light and in darkness, in winter and in summer, and in its own storehouse is an angel. 20. The spirit of the dew has its dwelling at the ends of heaven, and it is contiguous with the storehouses of the rain; its own course takes place in winter and in summer, and its cloud and the cloud of the mist are associated, and the one gives to the other. 21. When the spirit of the rain moves out of its storehouse, the angels come, open the storehouse and bring it out; and when it spreads over all the dry ground, it unites with the water that is upon the dry ground, [and when... it unites at all times with the water that is upon the dry ground.] 22. For the waters are for those who dwell upon the dry ground, for they are for the dry ground a food (that comes) from the Most High who is in heaven; that is why the rain has a measure, and the angels receive it (?). 23. I saw all this as far as the garden of the righteous.</p>

<p class="v">24. And the angel of peace who was with me said to me: "These two monsters, who befit the greatness of the Lord of the Universe, are fed so that [... the chastisement of the Lord of spirits may not come in vain], and it (the chastisement) will kill the little ones with their mother and the children with their father. 25. When the chastisement of the Lord of spirits shall come heavily upon them, it will come heavily so that the chastisement of the Lord of spirits may not come upon them in vain. Then judgment shall take place in his mercy and in his patience."]</p>

### Chapter 61 <span class="chap-roman">(LXI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The angels go to measure the dwelling-place of the righteous. Judgment of the saints by the Elect One.</p>

<p class="v">1. Now I saw in those days: long cords were given to these angels, and they took wings and flew away, and they went toward the north.</p>

<p class="v">2. And I questioned the angel, saying to him: "Why have they taken these cords and gone away?" He said to me: "They have gone to measure."</p>

<p class="v">3. And the angel who walked with me said to me: "These (angels) bring to the righteous the measures of the righteous and the measuring-lines of the righteous, that they may rely upon the name of the Lord of spirits for ever and ever. 4. The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect, and these measures are those that shall be given to the faith, and that shall establish righteousness. 5. These measures shall reveal all the secrets of the abyss of the earth, and those who were destroyed by the desert, and those who were swallowed up by the fish of the sea and by the beasts, so that they may return and rely upon the day of the Elect One, for there is nothing that perishes before the Lord of spirits, and there is nothing that can perish. 6. And all those who are in the height of heaven have received a command, and a power, and a single voice, and a single light like fire. 7. And him (the Elect One?) first, with the voice (?), they blessed and exalted him, they praised him with wisdom, and they were wise through the word and through the spirit of life.</p>

<p class="v">8. "And the Lord of spirits has set the Elect One upon a throne of glory, he shall judge all the works of the saints in the height of heaven, and their works shall be weighed in the balance. 9. When he shall lift up his face to judge their secret ways by the word of the name of the Lord of spirits, and their path by the way of the righteous judgment of the Lord of spirits, they shall all speak with a single voice, and they shall bless and praise and exalt and proclaim holy the name of the Lord of spirits. 10. And it shall proclaim (him), all the host of the heavens, and all the saints on high, and the host of the Lord of the Universe, the Cherubim, the Seraphim, the Ophanim, all the angels of power and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers that are upon the dry ground and upon the water." 11. On that day, they shall lift up their voice, and they shall bless, they shall praise and they shall exalt in the spirit of faithfulness, in the spirit of mercy, in the spirit of righteousness and peace and in the spirit of goodness, and they shall all say with a single voice: "Blessed is and blessed be the name of the Lord of spirits, for ever and unto eternity." 12. They shall bless him, all those who do not sleep in the height of heaven; they shall bless him, all the saints who are in heaven, and all the elect who dwell in the garden of life, and every spirit of light that shall be able to bless and praise and exalt and proclaim holy your blessed name, and all flesh that shall praise and bless beyond all (its) strength your name for ever and ever. 13. For great is the mercy of the Lord of spirits, and he is slow to anger, and all his works and the measure of his works he has revealed to the righteous and to the elect, in the name of the Lord of spirits.</p>

### Chapter 62 <span class="chap-roman">(LXII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Judgment of the kings and the mighty — Happiness of the Righteous.</p>

<p class="v">1. Thus the Lord commanded the kings, and the mighty, and the great, and those who dwell upon the earth, and he said: "Open your eyes and lift up your horns (to see) whether you will be able to recognize the Elect One." 2. And the Lord of spirits sat upon the throne of his glory, the Spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him (the Elect One), and the word of his mouth put all sinners to death, and all the wicked were destroyed before his face.</p>

<p class="v">3. On that day, all the kings, and the mighty, and those who possess the earth, shall stand up, and they shall see him and recognize him as he sits upon the throne of his glory; righteousness shall be judged before him, and no vain word shall be spoken before him. 4. And pain shall come upon them as upon a woman in labor, whose delivery is difficult, when her child comes to the opening of the womb, and she suffers to give birth. 5. Half of them shall look at the other half, and they shall be terrified; they shall cast down their faces, and pain shall seize them when they see this Son of man sitting upon the throne of his glory.</p>

<p class="v">6. And the kings and the mighty and all those who possess the earth shall praise, bless, and exalt him who reigns over all that is secret. 7. For before him is hidden the Son of man, and the Most High kept him before his power and revealed him to the elect. 8. And the assembly of the elect and of the saints shall be sown, and all the elect shall stand before him on that day.</p>

<p class="v">9. And all the kings, and the mighty, and the great, and those who rule over the dry ground, shall fall upon their faces before him, and they shall worship, and they shall hope in this Son of man, and they shall beseech him and ask him for mercy. 10. But this Lord of spirits shall press them to hasten to go out from before his face, and he shall fill their faces with shame, and darkness shall gather upon their faces. 11. And he shall deliver them to the angels for chastisement, that they may punish them, who have oppressed his children and his own elect. 12. And they shall be a spectacle to the righteous and to his elect; they shall rejoice over them, because the wrath of the Lord of spirits weighs heavily upon them, and his sword is drunk with them (that is, with their blood).</p>

<p class="v">13. But the righteous and the elect shall be saved on that day, and they shall no longer see the face of sinners and of the wicked henceforth. 14. And the Lord of spirits shall dwell over them, and with this Son of man they shall eat, they shall lie down and rise up for ever and ever. 15. And the righteous and the elect shall rise from the earth, they shall cease to cast down their faces, and they shall put on garments of glory. 16. And such shall be your garments: garments of life from the Lord of spirits, and your garments shall not grow old, and your glory shall not pass away before the Lord of spirits.</p>

### Chapter 63 <span class="chap-roman">(LXIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The kings and the mighty plead in vain with their judge.</p>

<p class="v">1. In those days, the mighty and the kings who possess the dry ground shall beseech the angels of chastisement to whom they have been delivered, to give them a little rest, that they may fall down before the Lord of spirits and worship him, and that they may confess their sins before him. 2. And they shall bless, and they shall praise the Lord of spirits, and they shall say:</p>

<p class="v">"Blessed be the Lord of spirits, the Lord of kings, the Lord of the mighty, the Lord of the rich, the Lord of glory, and the Lord of wisdom; he lights up everything that is secret. 3. Your power (endures) for the generations of generations, and your glory for ever and ever. All your secrets are deep and without number, and your righteousness is immeasurable. 4. Now we acknowledge that we must praise and bless the Lord of kings, and him who reigns over all kings."</p>

<p class="v">5. And they shall say: "Who will give us rest to glorify (you), and to give (you) thanks, and to confess (you) in the presence of your glory? 6. Now we sigh after a little rest, and we do not find it; we are driven away and we possess (nothing); the light has vanished before us, and darkness is our dwelling for ever and ever. 7. For before him we did not confess and we did not praise the name of the Lord of spirits, and we did not praise our Lord, but our hope was in the scepter of our dominion and in our glory. 8. So on the day of our affliction and of our tribulation, he did not save us, and we find no rest to confess that our Lord is faithful in all his works, and (in) his judgment, and (in) his righteousness, and that his judgment shows no partiality to anyone. 9. We pass far from his face because of our deeds, and all our sins have been counted with justice."</p>

<p class="v">10. Then they shall say to them (to the angels of chastisement): "Our soul is sated with the goods of iniquity, but they do not keep us from going down from their bosom into the sufferings of Sheol."</p>

<p class="v">11. And after this their face shall be filled with darkness and confusion before this Son of man, and they shall be driven away from before his face, and the sword shall remain before his face in the midst of them.</p>

<p class="v">12. Thus says the Lord of spirits: "Such is the lot and the chastisement of the mighty, and of the kings, and of the great, and of those who possess the dry ground, before the Lord of spirits."</p>

### Chapter 64 <span class="chap-roman">(LXIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Place of the chastisement of the wicked angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. Then I saw other faces hidden in that place. 2. I heard the voice of an angel, saying: "These are the angels who came down upon the earth, and who revealed to the children of men what is secret, and who taught the children of men to commit sin."</p>

### Chapter 65 <span class="chap-roman">(LXV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch foretells to Noah the chastisement of other men and his own preservation.</p>

<p class="v">[1. In those days, Noah saw that the earth was tottering and that its destruction was near. 2. And he departed from there and went to the ends of the earth, and he cried out to his grandfather Enoch, and Noah said three times in a sorrowful voice: "Hear me, hear me, hear me."</p>

<p class="v">3. And I said to him: "Tell me what is happening on the earth, that the earth is thus in travail and is shaken? Perhaps I too shall perish with it."</p>

<p class="v">4. After this there was a great shaking upon the earth, then a voice was heard from heaven, and I fell upon my face. 5. And Enoch my grandfather came, stood near me, and said to me: "Why have you uttered toward me a cry of sorrow and lamentations?"</p>

<p class="v">6. Then a command went out from before the face of the Lord concerning those who dwell upon the dry ground, that their ruin might be accomplished, for they have known all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the satans, and all their secret powers, and all the powers of those who work evil spells, and the power of sorceries, and the power of those who cast works of metal over all the earth, 7. and how silver is produced from the dust of the earth, and how molten metal is made upon the earth. 8. For lead and tin are not produced by the earth as the first (silver) is: it is a spring that produces them, and an angel stands there, and this angel is preeminent.</p>

<p class="v">9. After this my grandfather Enoch took me by the hand, and he raised me up and said to me: "Go, for I have questioned the Lord of spirits concerning this shaking upon the earth."</p>

<p class="v">10. And he said to me: "It is because of their iniquity that their chastisement is accomplished, and no account shall be taken in my presence of the months (during) which they sought to learn that the earth would be destroyed together with those who dwell in it. 11. As for these (the angels), there shall never be conversion for them, for they showed them (men) what is secret, and they are the ones who have been condemned. But as for you, my son, the Lord of spirits knows that you are pure and free from this reproach concerning the mysteries. 12. And he has made your name firm among the saints, and he will preserve you among those who dwell upon the dry ground, and he will make your race firm in righteousness for royalty and for great honors, and from your race shall come forth a fountain of righteous and of saints, and they shall be innumerable for ever."</p>

### Chapter 66 <span class="chap-roman">(LXVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The angels of chastisement prepare to loose the powers of the water.</p>

<p class="v">1. And after this he showed me the angels of chastisement, who were ready to come and loose all the powers of the water that is beneath the earth, that it might serve for the chastisement and the destruction of all those who remain and dwell upon the dry ground. 2. And the Lord of spirits commanded the angels who were going out not to lift up their hands, but to watch, for these angels were (set) over the power of the waters.</p>

<p class="v">3. And I went out from before the face of Enoch.</p>

### Chapter 67 <span class="chap-roman">(LXVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="v">Promises of God to Noah. — The rivers of fire where the wicked angels are chastised and where one day the kings and the mighty shall be punished.</p>

<p class="v">1. In those days, the word of the Lord of the Universe came (to me), and he said to me: "Noah, your lot has come up before me, a lot in which there is no reproach, a lot of love and of equity. 2. And now the angels are going to work with wood, and when the angels have finished this (work), I will stretch out my hand over it, and I will keep it, and the race of life shall come forth from it, and there shall be a change so that the earth may not remain empty. 3. And I will make your race firm before me for ever and ever, but I will scatter those who dwell with you; I will not test (your race) upon the face of the dry ground, and it shall be blessed, and it shall multiply upon the dry ground in the name of the Lord."</p>

<p class="v">4. And he will shut up the angels who showed iniquity, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had first shown me, to the west, near the mountains of gold, of silver, of iron, of molten metal, and of tin. 5. And I saw this valley, where there was a great disturbance, and a disturbance of the waters. 6. And when all this was accomplished, from that fiery "molten metal" and from the agitation that stirred them (the waters) in that place, there arose an odor of sulfur, and it mingled with these waters, and this valley where (were) the angels who had seduced (men) burns beneath this earth. 7. And from its valleys come forth rivers of fire, where these angels who seduced those who dwell upon the dry ground are chastised.</p>

<p class="v">8. These waters shall serve in those days for the kings, and the mighty, and the great, and those who dwell upon the dry ground, for the healing of the flesh and for the chastisement of the spirit; but their spirit is full of voluptuousness, so that their flesh shall be chastised, because they have denied the Lord of spirits; and they see their chastisement every day without confessing his name. 9. The more intensely their flesh is burned, the more change takes place in (their) spirit for ever and ever, [for there is no one before the Lord of spirits who utters a vain word.] 10. For judgment shall come upon them, because they believe in the voluptuousness of their flesh, and because they deny the Spirit of the Lord.</p>

<p class="v">11. In those days, there is a change in these same waters, for when these angels are chastised in these waters, the heat of these springs of water is changed, and when the angels rise up, this water of the springs is (again) changed, and it grows cold. 12. And I heard Michael take up the word there and say: "This chastisement with which the angels are chastised is a testimony for the kings and for the mighty who possess the dry ground. 13. For these waters of chastisement are for the healing of the flesh of the kings and for the voluptuousness of their flesh, but they do not see and they do not believe that these waters will be changed and will become a fire burning for ever."</p>

### Chapter 68 <span class="chap-roman">(LXVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Michael and Raphael marvel at the severity of the chastisement of the angels.</p>

<p class="v">1. After this, my grandfather Enoch gave me the explanation of all the secrets in a book, and (also) the parables that had been given to him, and he gathered them together for me in the words of the book of parables.</p>

<p class="v">2. And that day Michael took up the word to say to Raphael: "The power of the Spirit carries me away and vexes me concerning the severity of the chastisement of the secrets, the chastisement <of the angels>: who is he that will be able to endure the rigorous chastisement that has been exercised, and before which they melt away?"</p>

<p class="v">3. And Michael took up the word again and said to Raphael: "Who is he whose heart would not be touched concerning it (the chastisement), and whose loins would not be troubled by this word of chastisement that has been uttered against those among them who have been driven away thus?"</p>

<p class="v">4. And it came to pass, when Michael stood before the Lord of spirits, that he said to Raphael: "I will not (nevertheless) be for them in the eyes of the Lord, for the Lord of spirits is angered against them, because they act as though they were the Lord. 5. Therefore all that is secret shall come against them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall receive his portion, but they alone have received their chastisement for ever and ever."</p>

### Chapter 69 <span class="chap-roman">(LXIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The names and the roles of the wicked angels. — The mysterious oath that they revealed.</p>

<p class="v">1. And after this judgment they shall be terrified and exasperated, because they showed this to those who dwell upon the dry ground.</p>

<p class="v">2. And here are the names of these angels, and such are their names: the first among them is Semyaza, the second Arstiqifa, the third Armên, the fourth Kôkabel, the fifth Touriel, the sixth Rumyal, the seventh Daniel, the eighth Neqel, the ninth Baraqiel, the tenth Azazel, the eleventh Armaros, the twelfth Bataryal, the thirteenth Basasaël, the fourteenth Hananel, the fifteenth Touriel, the sixteenth Simapisiel, the seventeenth Yetariel, the eighteenth Tumaël, the nineteenth Tariel, the twentieth Rumael, the twenty-first Azazel.</p>

<p class="v">3. And these are the chiefs of their angels, and the names of their chiefs of hundreds, of their chiefs of fifties, and of their chiefs of tens. 4. The name of the first is Yeqon: he is the one who seduced all the sons of the angels and made them come down upon the earth, and he seduced them through the daughters of men. 5. The name of the second is Asbeel: this one gave evil counsel to the [holy] sons of the angels: he led them to defile their flesh with the daughters of men. 6. The name of the third is Gadriel: he is the one who showed all the death-blows to the sons of men, it is he who seduced Eve, and it is he who showed the death-blows to the sons of men, and the shield, and the breastplate, and the sword for combat, and all the instruments of death to the sons of men. 7. From his hand they went out against those who dwell upon the dry ground, from that day and even unto the ages of ages. 8. The name of the fourth is Penemu'e: this one showed the sons of men the bitter and the sweet, and he showed them all the secrets of their wisdom (of the angels). 9. It is he who taught men to write with the water of soot (ink) and papyrus, and there are many who have gone astray on this account from eternity unto eternity and even to this day. 10. For men were not brought into the world to affirm their faithfulness thus with the reed-pen and the water of soot. 11. For men were created no differently than the angels, (but) to remain righteous and pure, and death, which corrupts everything, would not have reached them; but because of this knowledge that is theirs, they perish, and because of this power it (death) devours me.</p>

<p class="v">12. The name of the fifth is Kasdeya'e 2: he is the one who showed the sons of men all the evil plagues of the spirits and of the demons, and the plague of the embryo in the womb, that it might fall, and the plague of life, the bite of the serpent, and the plague that comes at noon, the son of the serpent whose name is Taba'et.</p>

<p class="v">13. And this is the number of Kasbeel, who showed the saints the head of the oath, when he dwelt on high in glory, and his name is Beqa. 14. This one (Kasbeel) asked Michael to show him the secret name, that he might mention it in the oath, so that those who showed the sons of men everything that is secret might tremble before this name and this oath.</p>

<p class="v">15. And here is the power of this oath: it is strong and mighty, and he (God) had deposited this oath, Aka'e, in the hand of Michael.</p>

<p class="v">16. And here are the secrets of this oath ... and it is strong in its oath. And by it heaven was suspended before the world was created, and even unto eternity. 17. And the earth has been founded upon the water, and from the secret (depths) of the mountains come beautiful waters, from the creation of the world even unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">18. And by this oath, the sea was created, and for its foundation, in the time of wrath, he gave it sand, and it does not cross (its limits) from the creation of the world even unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">19. And by this oath, the abysses have been made firm, and they are stable, and they do not change place from eternity unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">20. And by this oath, the sun and the moon accomplish their course, and they do not transgress their laws from eternity unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">21. And by this oath, the stars accomplish their course, and he calls them by their name, and they answer him from eternity unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">22. And likewise (he calls) the spirits of the water, of the winds, and of all the breaths, and their paths among all the hosts of the spirits.</p>

<p class="v">23. [And there are kept the voice of the thunder and the light of the lightning, and there are kept the storehouses of the hail, and the storehouses of the frost, and the storehouses of the mist, and the storehouses of the rain and of the dew.]</p>

<p class="v">24. All these are faithful and give thanks before the Lord of spirits, and they praise (him) with all their strength, and their nourishment is in every act of thanksgiving, and they give thanks, and they praise and exalt the name of the Lord of spirits for ever and ever.</p>

<p class="v">25. Upon them (the spirits) this oath is made firm, they are kept by it; their paths are kept, and their ways shall not be corrupted.]</p>

<p class="v">26. And they felt great joy, and they blessed, and praised, and exalted (the Lord) because the name of this Son of man had been revealed to them. 27. He has sat down upon the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgment has been given to the Son of man, and he shall put away and shall destroy sinners from before the face of the earth, and (also) those who have seduced the world. 28. They shall be bound with chains, and in the place where they shall have been gathered together for destruction they shall be shut up, and all their works shall vanish from the face of the earth. 29. And from then on there shall be nothing corruptible, for this Son of man has appeared and has sat down upon the throne of his glory, and all evil shall depart and go away from before his face; but the word of this Son of man shall remain before the Lord of spirits.</p>

<p class="v">Such is the third parable of Enoch.</p>

### Chapter 70 <span class="chap-roman">(LXX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Assumption of Enoch.</p>

<p class="v">[1. It came to pass afterward that his name (Enoch's) was exalted, in his lifetime, near this Son of man and near the Lord of spirits, far from those who dwell upon the dry ground. 2. He was lifted up upon the chariot of the wind, and the name (of Enoch) disappeared from the midst of them (of those who dwell upon the dry ground).</p>

<p class="v">3. From that day I was no longer counted in their midst, and he (God) made me sit between two regions, between the north and the west, there where the angels had taken cords in order to measure for me the dwelling-place of the elect and of the righteous. 4. And there I saw the first fathers and the saints who have dwelt in this place from eternity.]</p>

### Chapter 71 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch is admitted to contemplate the secrets and the splendors of the heavens. — Promises of the Head of Days.</p>

<p class="v">[1. It came to pass afterward that my soul was hidden, and it rose up into the heavens, and I saw the sons of the holy angels walking upon flames of fire; their garments were white, as well as their tunic, and their face resplendent like crystal. 2. And I saw two rivers of fire; the light of that fire shone like the hyacinth, and I fell upon my face before the Lord of spirits.</p>

<p class="v">3. The angel Michael, one of the chiefs of the angels, took my right hand, and he raised me up and led me to where all the secrets are, and he showed me all the secrets of mercy, and he showed me all the secrets of righteousness, 4. and he showed me all the secrets of the ends of heaven, and all the storehouses of the stars and of all the lights, from which they rise in the presence of the saints. 5. And he hid my spirit, and I, Enoch, (was) in the heaven of heavens, and I saw there, in the midst of that light, something like a house that was built of blocks of ice, and among these blocks (there were) tongues of living fire. 6. And my spirit saw a circle that surrounded this house with fire, from its four corners even to those rivers full of living fire that surrounded this house. 7. And (there were) around it the Seraphim, and the Cherubim, and the Ophanim: these are they who do not sleep and who guard the throne of his glory (the Lord's).</p>

<p class="v">8. I saw innumerable angels, thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads, surrounding this house, and Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, and the holy angels who are in the height of the heavens, went into this house and came out of it. 9. So they came out of this house, Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel, and a multitude of holy angels, innumerable. 10. And with them (was) the Head of Days; his head was white and pure as wool, as well as his garments, which were indescribable.</p>

<p class="v">11. I fell upon my face, and my whole body melted, and my soul was changed, and I cried out with a loud voice in a mighty breath, and I blessed, and I praised, and I exalted (the Lord). 12. And these blessings that came forth from my mouth were (found) pleasing before this Head of Days. 13. And this Head of Days came with Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, and thousands and myriads of innumerable angels. 14. And it came to me, and it greeted me with its voice and said to me: "You, you are the son of man who was begotten for righteousness, and righteousness dwells upon you, and the righteousness of the Head of Days will not abandon you."</p>

<p class="v">15. And it said to me: "He (God) will call peace upon you in the name of the age to come, for from there peace has gone forth since the creation of the world, and thus it shall be upon you for ever and for ever and ever. 16. And all (peace) shall walk in your way while righteousness will never abandon you; with you shall be their dwelling, and with you their portion, and from you they shall not be separated, for ever and for ever and ever. 17. And thus it shall come to pass, for long days, with this Son of man, and peace shall belong to the righteous, and the straight way to the righteous, in the name of the Lord of spirits for ever and ever."]</p>

<p class="v">PART THREE</p>

<p class="v">BOOK OF THE CHANGE OF THE LUMINARIES OF HEAVEN</p>

<p class="v">(Chap. LXXII-LXXXII)</p>

### Chapter 72 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The law of the sun.</p>

<p class="v">1. Book of the change of the luminaries of heaven, each as they are according to their kinds, each according to their power and according to their time, each according to their name and the place of their birth, and according to their months; which Uriel, the holy angel who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their writing as it is, according to all the years of the world and even unto eternity, until the new work is made that shall remain unto eternity.</p>

<p class="v">2. Here is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary sun: its rising is at the gates of heaven that are on the side of the east, and its setting is at the gates of heaven that are in the west. 3. And I saw six gates that are there where the sun rises, and six gates that are there where the sun sets; and the moon rises and sets through these gates, as well as the guides of the stars with those who lead them. There are six (gates) in the east and six in the west, and all are one after another in good order, and many windows are to the right and to the left of these gates.</p>

<p class="v">4. The greatest luminary, whose name is sun, rises first, and its orbit is like the orbit of heaven, and it is entirely filled with a fire that lights and that burns. 5. The wind blows upon the chariot on which it rises, and the sun sets (disappearing) from heaven, and it returns toward the north to go to the east, and it is led in such a way as to enter by the gate (that is assigned to it) and to shine (again) upon the face of the heavens. 6. Thus it rises in the first month through the great gate; and it rises through the fourth of these six gates that are in the east. 7. At this fourth gate, from which the sun comes forth during the first month, there are twelve open windows, from which a flame comes forth when they open in their time.</p>

<p class="v">8. When the sun rises in the sky, it comes forth through this fourth gate for thirty mornings, and through the fourth gate in the west of the sky, it goes down regularly. 9. And at this time, the day is longer than the (preceding) day, and the night is shorter than the (preceding) night, for thirty mornings. 10. At this time, it (the day) is longer than the night by 2/9 of a day; and the day is exactly ten parts (= ninths), and the night is exactly eight parts.</p>

<p class="v">11. And the sun rises through this fourth gate and it sets through the fourth, and it returns to the fifth gate in the east for thirty mornings, and it rises through this gate and it sets in the fifth gate. 12. And then the day is longer by two parts, and the day is of eleven parts; the night is shorter and it is of seven parts.</p>

<p class="v">13. And it returns to the east and it enters into the sixth gate, and it rises and it sets through the sixth gate for thirty-one mornings, on account of its sign. 14. And at this time the day is longer than the night, and the day is double the night, and the day is of twelve parts; and the night is shorter, and it is of six parts.</p>

<p class="v">15. And the sun rises in such a way that the day becomes shorter, and the night longer; and the sun returns to the east and it enters into the sixth gate, and through it, it rises and it sets for thirty mornings. 16. And when the thirty mornings are accomplished, the day decreases by exactly one part, and the day is of eleven parts and the night of seven parts.</p>

<p class="v">17. And the sun comes out from the west through this sixth gate, and it goes to the east, and it rises through the fifth gate for thirty mornings, and it sets in the west again through the fifth gate of the west (sic), 18. At this time, the day decreases by two parts and the day is of ten parts and the night of eight parts.</p>

<p class="v">19. And the sun rises through this fifth gate and it sets through the fifth gate of the west, and it rises through the fourth gate on account of its sign, for thirty-one mornings, and it sets in the west. 20. At this time the day is equal to the night and becomes equal (to it), and the night is of nine parts, and the day of nine parts.</p>

<p class="v">21. And the sun rises through this gate and it sets in the west, and it returns to the east, and it rises through the third gate for thirty mornings, and it sets in the west through the third gate. 22. And at this time, the night is longer than the day, and the night is longer than the (preceding) night, and the day is shorter than the (preceding) day until the thirtieth morning, and the night is exactly of ten parts, and the day of eight parts.</p>

<p class="v">23. And the sun rises through this third gate and it sets through the third gate in the west; and it returns to the east, and the sun rises through the second gate in the east for thirty mornings, and likewise it sets through the second gate in the west of the sky. 24. And at this time, the night is of eleven parts, and the day of seven parts.</p>

<p class="v">25. And the sun rises at this time through this second gate, and it sets in the west through the second gate, and it returns to the east through the first gate for thirty-one mornings, and it sets through the first gate in the west of the sky. 26. And at this time, the night becomes longer and it is twice the day, and the night is exactly of twelve parts, and the day of six parts.</p>

<p class="v">27. And the sun has completed (the course of) its sections, and again it turns upon these sections, and it enters into all its gates for thirty mornings, and it sets in the west in the corresponding regions. 28. And at this time the night decreases in its length by a ninth, [that is to say, by one part,] and the night is of eleven parts and the day of seven parts.</p>

<p class="v">29. And the sun has returned and it has entered into the second gate in the east, and it returns upon these sections: for thirty mornings it rises and it sets. 30. And at that time, the night decreases in length, and the night is of ten parts, and the day is of eight parts.</p>

<p class="v">31. At that time, the sun rises through this second gate and it sets in the west and it returns to the east, and it rises through the third gate for thirty-one mornings, and it sets in the west of the sky. 32. And at that time, the night decreases and it is of nine parts and the day is of nine parts, and the night is equal to the day, and the year is exactly three hundred and sixty-four days.</p>

<p class="v">33. The length of the day and of the night, and the shortness of the day and of the night, are differentiated (lit.: separated) by the course of the sun. 34. This is why its course is longer day by day, and shorter night by night.</p>

<p class="v">35. And such is the law and the course of the sun and its return, when sixty times it returns and it rises, this great luminary which is called the sun for ever and ever. 36. And that which rises is the great luminary; and it is named according to its own appearance, as the Lord ordered it. 37. As it rises, so it sets, and it neither diminishes nor rests, but it runs day and night, and its light shines seven times more than that of the moon, but the dimensions of the two are equal.</p>
### Chapter 73 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">First law of the moon: its phases.</p>

<p class="v">1. After this law I saw a second law, (that) of the small luminary whose name is moon. 2. Its orbit is like the orbit of heaven, and the wind blows upon the chariot on which it rises, and light is given to it in measure. 3. And throughout the month its rising and its setting change, and its days are like the days of the sun, and when its light becomes equal (that is to say complete), it is the seventh part of the light of the sun. 4. And thus it rises: its head (its first quarter) rises on the side of the east on the thirtieth day, and at that time it appears and it is to you the beginning of the month on the thirtieth day, with the sun, through the gate where the sun rises. 5. And its half is visible (?) at a seventh, and all (the rest of) its disk is empty, without light, except the seventh part (of the half), the fourteenth of (all) its light.</p>

<p class="v">6. And at the time when it takes a seventh and a half of its light, its light is the thirteenth part and a half (of the whole).</p>

<p class="v">7. It sets with the sun, and when the sun rises the moon rises with it, and it takes a half-part of light, and on that night, at the beginning of its morning, at the beginning of the lunar day, the moon sets with the sun and it is in darkness during that night for thirteen and a half parts. 8. And it shines at that time with exactly a seventh (of the half), and it rises and it inclines to the east of the sun, and it shines during the rest of its days in the (other) thirteen parts.</p>

### Chapter 74 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Second law of the moon: the lunar year.</p>

<p class="v">1. I saw a second course and a(nother) law: by this law it accomplishes the course of the months. 2. And all this Uriel showed me, the holy angel who is the guide of them all, and I have described their position as he showed it to me, and I have described their months, as they are, and the aspect of their light until the fifteenth day is accomplished.</p>

<p class="v">2. By sevenths, it accomplishes all its light in the east; and by sevenths, it accomplishes all its darkness in the west. 4. And in certain months, it changes its setting; and in certain months, it accomplishes each of its courses. 5. For two months, it sets with the sun through those two gates that are in the middle, through the third and the fourth gate. 6. It rises for seven days, and it turns and returns again through the gate by which the sun rises; and (then) it accomplishes all its light (full moon); then it withdraws from the sun, and it enters for eight days through the sixth gate where the sun rises.</p>

<p class="v">7. And when the sun rises through the fourth gate, it rises for seven days (through the same gate) until it rises through the fifth, and again it returns for seven days through the fourth gate and it accomplishes all its light (full moon), and it withdraws and it enters through the first gate for eight days. 8. And again it returns for seven days through the fourth gate through which the sun rises. 9. Thus I saw their position, how the moons rise and the sun sets.</p>

<p class="v">10. In these days, one adds up five years, and there are thirty days of surplus for the sun; and all the days that one of these five years counts, when they are complete, are three hundred and sixty-four days. 11. And there comes the surplus of the sun and of the stars (which is) of six days; for five years, these six amount to (make) thirty days; (the course of) the moon is therefore inferior by thirty days to (that) of the sun and of the stars. 12. And the moon brings all the exact years according to their position for eternity; they neither advance nor delay by a day, but they (the moons) change the year with absolute exactness every three hundred and sixty-four days. 13. (There are) therefore for three (solar) years one thousand ninety-two days, and for five years one thousand eight hundred and twenty days, so that there are for eight years two thousand nine hundred and twelve days.</p>

<p class="v">14a. For the moon alone, its days amount in three (lunar) years to one thousand sixty-two days, and in five years it is less by fifty days. 15. And it is for five years seventeen hundred and seventy days, so that there are for the moon during eight years two thousand eight hundred and thirty-two days. 14b. [For at its going out (= at the total of the days of five years) one adds &lt;a thousand&gt; sixty-two days.] 16. [For there are lacking for eight years eighty days;] all the days that are lacking for eight years are eighty. 17. And the year is accomplished regularly according to the position of their world (of the moons), and the position of the sun, which rise (the sun and the moon) at the gates through which it (the sun) rises and sets during thirty days.</p>

### Chapter 75 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The intercalary days. — The angel Uriel appointed over the stars. The gates of the sun.</p>

<p class="v">1. The chiefs of the leaders of the thousand who are appointed over every creature and over all the stars, together with the four (days) that are added, are not distinct from their work, in accordance with the reckoning of the year, and they serve during four days that are not counted in the reckoning of the year. 2. And because of them men err concerning them, for these luminaries serve exactly the stations of the world, one at the first gate and one at the third gate, one at the fourth gate and one at the sixth gate, and the harmony of the world is accomplished in three hundred and sixty-four stations of the world. 3. For the signs, the times, the years and the days, Uriel made me see, the angel whom the Lord of glory has appointed over the world over all the luminaries of heaven, in heaven and in the world, so that the sun, the moon and the stars and all the serving creatures that turn upon all the chariots of heaven, may reign before the face of heaven and be seen upon the earth and be the guides of the day and of the night.</p>

<p class="v">4. Uriel also showed me twelve gates open in the orbit of the chariot of the sun in the heavens; through them go out the rays of the sun, and through them heat is spread over the earth when they are open at the times fixed for them. 5. [And (they serve also) the winds and the spirit of the dew, when they are open, open in the heavens, at the extremities.] 6. Twelve gates I saw in the heavens at the confines of the earth: from them come out the sun, the moon and the stars and every work of heaven to the east and to the west. 7. And there are many windows open to the right and to the left, and each window spreads heat in its time; they correspond to those gates through which the stars rise as he (God) has commanded them, and through which they set according to their number. 8. And I saw in the heavens chariots that traverse the world above these gates; in these (chariots) turn the stars that do not set. 9. And there is one greater than all, which is the one that makes the circuit of the whole world.</p>

### Chapter 76 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The twelve winds and their gates.</p>

<p class="v">1. At the confines of the earth, I saw twelve gates open for all the winds; it is from them that the winds come out and that they blow upon the earth. 2. Three of them are open on the face of heaven and three to the west; three to the right of heaven and three to the left. 3. And the first three are those that are on the side of the east, and there are three at the south, and the next three are those that are to the left on the side of the north, and there are three at the west. 4. Through four of them come out winds of blessing and of salvation, and through the (other) eight come out winds of chastisement; when they are sent, they bring ruin to all the earth, and to the water that is upon it, and to all who dwell upon it and to all who are in the water and on the dry land. 5. The first wind, whose name is the eastern, comes out from these gates, through the first gate which is on the side of the east and (which) inclines toward the south; through it come out the desolation of the dry land, and the heat, and ruin. 6. And through the second gate, the one in the middle, comes out the good (?), and through it come out the rain, and the fruit, and salvation, and the dew. And through the third gate, on the side of the north, come out cold and dryness. 7. And after these, come out the winds from the side of the south through three gates: the first, through the first of these gates which inclines toward the side of the east, comes out as a wind of heat. 8. And through the middle gate which is nearby, come out good odors, and dew, and rain, and salvation, and life. 9. And through the third gate which is on the side of the west, come out dew, and rain, and locusts, and desolation.</p>

<p class="v">10. And after these, (come) the winds from the side of the north, [whose name is sea, and that which comes out] through the seventh gate which is to the east, [which inclines to the south;] through it come dew and rain, locusts and ruin. 11. And from the right gate in the middle come out life, and rain, and dew, and salvation. And through the third gate which is to the west, [which inclines to the north,] through it come out the cloud, and the frost, and the snow, and the rain, and the dew, and the locusts.</p>

<p class="v">12. After these (come) the [four] winds that are to the west. Through the first gate which is on the side of the north come out dew, and snow, and cold, and frost, and coolness. 13. And through the middle gate come out dew and rain, salvation and blessing; and through the last gate which is at the south come out drought and ruin, heat and perdition. 14. And the twelve gates of the four winds of the heavens are completed, and I have shown you all their law, and all their chastisement, and all their salvation, O my son Mathusala.</p>

### Chapter 77 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXVII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The four regions of the universe. — The seven mountains. The seven rivers. The seven islands.</p>

<p class="v">[1. The first region is called the eastern, for it is the first. The second is called the south, for the Most High descends there, and the eternally blessed descends there above all. 2. The region of the west, its name is the imperfect, for there are diminished and there descend all the lights of heaven. 3. The fourth region, whose name is north, is divided into three parts: the first of them is the dwelling of men, the second is in the seas of the waters, and in the abysses, and in the forests, and in the rivers, and in the darkness, and in the cloud; and the third part is in the garden of righteousness.</p>

<p class="v">4. I saw seven high mountains, higher than all the mountains that are on the earth; from them comes the frost; and the days and the season and the year pass. 5. I saw seven rivers on the earth, greater than all the rivers; one of them comes from the west, into the great sea it pours out its waters. 6. And the two (other) go from the north to the sea, and they pour out their waters into the Erythraean Sea, to the east. 7. And the four others come out from the side of the north to their sea: &lt;two to&gt; the Erythraean Sea and two into the great sea; they pour out there — [some say: into the desert]. 8. Seven great islands I saw in the sea and near the earth; two near the earth and five in the great sea.]</p>

### Chapter 78 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXVIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The sun and the moon.</p>

<p class="v">1. Here are the names of the sun: one is Oryarès and the other Tomas. 2. And the moon has four names: its first name is Asonya, and the second Ebelâ, and the third Benâsé, and the fourth Erâ'e. 3. These are the two great luminaries; their orbit is like the orbit of heaven, and the proportions of their two orbits are equal.</p>

<p class="v">4. In the disk of the sun there are seven parts of light that are added to it more than to the moon; and in measure it (the light) is put (into the moon) until the seventh part of the sun has passed. 5. And (the two luminaries) set and enter into the gates of the west, and they go around by the north, and through the gates of the east they rise upon the face of heaven.</p>

<p class="v">6. And when the moon rises, it appears in heaven, and it has half of a seventh of light, and in fourteen (days) it accomplishes all its light. 7. And fifteen parts of light are put into it: in fifteen days, its light is accomplished according to the sign of the year, and it is of fifteen parts, and the moon waxes (lit.: makes itself) by half-sevenths. 8. And in its waning, on the first day it wanes to fourteen parts of its light; and on the second, it wanes to thirteen parts; and on the third, it wanes to twelve parts; and on the fourth, it wanes to eleven parts; and on the fifth, it wanes to ten parts; and on the sixth, it wanes to nine parts; and on the seventh, it wanes to eight parts; and on the eighth, it wanes to seven parts; and on the ninth, it wanes to six parts; and on the tenth, it wanes to five parts; and on the eleventh, it wanes to four parts; and on the twelfth, it wanes to three parts; and on the thirteenth, it wanes to two parts; and on the fourteenth, it wanes to half of the seventh of all its light; and on the fifteenth is consumed what remained of the whole. 9. And in certain months, it is twenty-nine days in the month, and there are some in which it is twenty-eight days.</p>

<p class="v">10. Uriel showed me another law: when the light is placed in the moon and from what point it is cast by the sun. 11. All the time that the moon advances (and journeys), it casts its light before the sun; in fourteen days its light is full, and when it is wholly kindled, its light is full in heaven. 12. The first day it is called new moon, for on that day the light rises above it. 13. And it is exactly full at the time when the sun descends into the west and when it rises from the east during the night, and the moon shines throughout the whole night until the sun rises facing it and the moon appears facing the sun. 14. Where the light of the moon begins (lit.: goes out), there it wanes again until all its light is consumed and the days of the month pass and its disk is empty, without light. 15. And for three months it makes thirty days in its time, and for three months it acts by twenty-nine days; it is in these days that it performs its waning in the first period and through the first gate in one hundred seventy-seven days. 16. And at the time of its rising, for three months it appears for thirty days, and for three months it appears for twenty-nine days. 17. In the night it appears for twenty days like a man; and in the day, like the sky; for it has nothing else but its light.</p>

### Chapter 79 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXIX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Summary of the laws of the stars.</p>

<p class="v">1. And now, my son, I have shown you everything, and the law of all the stars of the heavens is finished.</p>

<p class="v">2. He has therefore shown me all their laws for all the days, and for all the seasons that exercise power, and for the whole year and for its end, and for the rules of all the months and all the weeks; 3. and the waning of the moon which takes place through the sixth gate, for through this sixth gate its light is perfected, and through it takes place the beginning of the waning; 4. &lt;and the waning&gt; which takes place through the first gate in its time, until one hundred seventy-seven days are accomplished, or, according to the law of the week, twenty-five (weeks) and two days; 5. and (he showed me) that (the moon) lags behind the sun and according to the law of the stars by five days in one period exactly, and (he showed me) when this place that you see is perfected. 6. Such is the vision and the image of every light that Uriel showed me, the great angel who is their guide.</p>

### Chapter 80 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXX)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Wonders of the last days. Punishment of sinners.</p>

<p class="v">1. In those days, Uriel, the angel, spoke to me and said: "Behold, I have shown you everything, O Enoch, and I have revealed everything to you so that you may see this sun and this moon, and those who guide the stars of the heavens and those who make them turn, their work and their time and their rising.</p>

<p class="v">2. "In the days of sinners the years will be shortened, and their seed will be delayed on their land and on their fields; and every work on the earth will be changed and will no longer appear in its time, and the rain will be withheld, and the sky will hold it back. 3. And at that time the fruit of the earth will be delayed, and it will not grow in its time, and the fruit of the trees will be withheld in its time. 4. And the moon will change its law and it will not appear in its time. 5. And in those days there will appear in the sky and there will come barrenness upon the top (lit.: at the end) of a great chariot in the west, and it will shine extraordinarily, more than (the law of light requires). 6. And many of the chiefs of the stars of the order will err, and these will change their ways and their work, and they will not appear at the times prescribed for them. 7. And all the laws of the stars will be closed to sinners, and the thoughts of those who live upon the earth will err concerning them, and they will turn aside from all their ways and they will err and they will regard them (the stars) as gods. 8. And evil will multiply against them and chastisement will come upon them to destroy them all.</p>

### Chapter 81 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">The tablets of heaven. — Mission of Enoch</p>

<p class="v">[1. And he said to me: "Look, Enoch, at the tablets of heaven, and read what is written there and understand everything distinctly 2. And I looked at the tablets of heaven and I read everything that was written and I understood everything, and I read the book of all the works of men and of all the children of flesh who are upon the earth unto the eternal generations. 3. And at once I blessed the great Lord, the king of glory forever, because he made all the creatures of the world, and I praised the Lord for his patience, and I blessed him for the children of Adam. 4. And then I said: "Happy the man who dies righteous and good, and against whom no book of iniquity is written or found on the day of judgment."</p>

<p class="v">5. And these seven holy ones brought me and set me down upon the earth before the gate of my house, and they said to me: "Make known everything to Mathusala your son, and teach all his children that no being of flesh is righteous before the Lord, for he is their creator. 6. We will leave you a year with your son until you regain your strength to instruct your sons and write for them and bear witness to all your children; and in the second year you will be taken from among them. Let your heart be strong, for the good will teach righteousness to the good, the righteous will rejoice with the righteous and they will greet one another. 8. But the sinner will die with the sinner, and the apostate will be submerged with the apostate. 9. And those who accomplish righteousness will die by the work of men, and they will be gathered together by the work of the wicked."</p>

<p class="v">10. And in those days they ceased to converse with me, and I went in to my own, blessing the Lord of the world.]</p>

### Chapter 82 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Recommendations to Mathusala. — The intercalary days. The stars and their guides.</p>

<p class="v">1. Now, O my son Mathusala, I tell you all these things and I write (them) for you, and I have revealed everything to you, and I have given you the books (that record) all these things. Keep, O my son, the book from the hand of your father, and likewise give it to the generations of the world. 2. I have given wisdom to you and to your children and to the children you will have, so that they may give to their children of the generations (to come) this wisdom above their thoughts. 8. And they do not sleep, those who understand, but they lend an ear to learn this wisdom; and it is more useful to those who eat (of it) than exquisite food.</p>

<p class="v">4. Happy are all the righteous, happy are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and who do not sin like sinners, in the reckoning of all their days, during which the sun journeys through the heavens, enters and goes out through the gates for thirty days, with the chiefs of the thousands of the order of the stars, with the four that are added, who make the separation between the four parts of the year, who guide them and who enter with them into the four (additional) days.</p>

<p class="v">5. Concerning them men err and they do not count them in the reckoning of the whole time, for men err concerning them and they do not know them exactly. 6. For they belong to the computation of the year, and they are truly assigned for eternity, one at the first gate, one at the third, one at the fourth and one at the sixth; and the year is complete in three hundred and sixty-four (days).</p>

<p class="v">7. Now true is his word (Uriel's) and exact his computation which is inscribed; for Uriel showed me the luminaries, and the months, and the feasts, and the years, and the days, and he breathed upon me what the Lord of every creature of the world commanded him concerning me touching the host of heaven. 8. And he has power over the night and over the day in heaven, to make light shine upon men: the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and all the powers of the heavens that turn upon their orbit. 9. And such is the law of the stars that set in their places, in their times, in their feasts and in their months.</p>

<p class="v">10. And here are the names of those who guide them, of those who watch and enter in their time, who guide them in their places, and according to their laws, and at their epochs, and in their months, and according to their power and in their stations. 11. Their four guides enter first, who separate the four parts of the year, and then the twelve chiefs of the orders who separate the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days), there are the chiefs of the thousands who distinguish the days; and for the four that are added to them, there are those who distinguish as guides the four parts of the year. 12. These chiefs of the thousands are interposed between the guide and the guided, each after a station, and their guides separate (the stations). 18. And here are the names of the guides who separate the four fixed parts of the year: Melkiel, Elimelek, Mélêyal, and Nârel. 14. And the names of those who guide them are: Adnarel, Iyasusâel and Iyelumiel: these three are those who follow the chiefs of the orders, and there is one who comes behind the three chiefs of the orders who follow these chiefs of the stations who separate the four parts of the year.</p>

<p class="v">15. At the head of the year rises the first, and Melkiel reigns, whose name is Tama'âni and sun; and all the days that are in his power, over which he rules, are (in number) ninety-one days. 16. And here are the signs of the days that appear on the earth at the time of his power: heat, burning and calm; and all the trees bear fruit, and the leaves grow on all the trees; and the harvest of wheat, and the flower of the rose, and all the flowers that grow in the fields, and the winter trees dry up. 17. Here are the names of the guides who are under him: Berkiel, Zalbesâel, and the other chief of the thousand who is added, by whom the days of their power are ended, has for name Héloyasêph.</p>

<p class="v">18. The other guide who comes after him is Elimelek, who is called "bright sun", and all the days of his light are (in number) ninety-one days. 19. And here are the signs of (these) days on the earth: heat and dryness, the trees ripen their fruits and they give all their fruits ripe and ready; the ewes mate and they conceive, and all the fruits of the earth are gathered and everything that is in the fields and at the winepress; and this takes place in the days of his power. 20. And here are the names and the orders and the guides of the chiefs of the thousands: Gédâel, Kêel and Hêel; and the name of the chief of the thousand who is added to them is Asfâel; and the days of their power are ended.</p>

<p class="v">PART IV</p>

<p class="v">THE BOOK OF DREAMS</p>

<p class="v">(Chapters LXXXIII-XC)</p>

### Chapter 83 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXIII)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">First dream of Enoch. His grandfather Malaleel explains it to him.</p>

<p class="v">1. And now therefore, I am going to show you, my son Mathusala, all the visions that I have seen; I am going to relate them before you. 2. I saw two visions before taking a wife, and the one did not resemble the other: the first when I was learning to write, and the second before taking your mother; I saw a terrible vision, and concerning them I supplicated the Lord.</p>

<p class="v">3. I was lying in the house of Malaleel, my grandfather; I saw in a vision the sky brought down, taken away and falling upon the earth. 4. And when it fell upon the earth, I saw the earth swallowed up in a great abyss, the mountains suspended upon the mountains, the hills sinking upon the hills, and great trees separated from their trunks, cast down and submerged in the abyss. 5. Then a word fell into my mouth, and I lifted up (my voice) to cry out, and I said: "The earth is destroyed."</p>

<p class="v">6. Then Malaleel, my grandfather, woke me, as I was lying near him, and said to me: "Why do you cry out thus, my son, and why do you groan in this way?"</p>

<p class="v">7. Then I related to him the whole vision that I had seen, and he said to me: "Just as you have seen a terrible thing, my son, and terrible is the vision of your dream concerning the mysteries of all the sins of the earth, so it (the earth) is about to be swallowed up in the abysses, and to be ruined with a great ruin. 8. Now, my son, arise and pray to the Lord of glory, since you are faithful, that a remnant may remain on the earth and that he (God) may not destroy the whole earth. 9. My son, all this must come from heaven upon the earth, and there will be upon the earth a great ruin."</p>

<p class="v">10. Then I arose, and I prayed, and I supplicated, and I asked, and I wrote my prayer for the generations of the world, and I will show you everything, my son Mathusala. 11. Now when I went down and I saw the sky, and the sun rise in the east, and the moon go down in the west, and a few stars, and the whole earth, and everything that he made in the beginning, I blessed the Lord of judgment, and I extolled him, because he makes the sun rise through the windows of the east, so that it climbs up, and shines upon the face of heaven, and sets out to travel the path that has been shown to it.</p>

### Chapter 84 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXIV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Enoch asks God not to destroy his posterity.</p>

<p class="v">1. And I lifted up my hands in righteousness, and I blessed the Holy and Great One, and I spoke with the breath of my mouth, and with the tongue of flesh that God has made for the children of the flesh of man, so that they might use it to speak; and he has given them a breath, and a tongue, and a mouth so that they might speak with it.</p>

<p class="v">2. "Blessed are you, O Lord, king great and mighty in your greatness. Lord of every heavenly creature, King of kings, and God of the whole universe. Your empire and your kingship and your greatness endure forever and unto the ages of ages, and in all the generations of generations your power. 2. All the heavens are your throne for eternity, and the whole earth is the footstool of your feet forever and unto the ages of ages. 8. For it is you who made and who rule all things, and there is no work that is difficult for you, not one; and no wisdom is lacking to you or departs from its life (which is) your throne, nor from your face. And you know, and you see, and you hear all things, and there is nothing hidden from you, for you see all things.</p>

<p class="v">4. "And now therefore, the angels of your heavens sin, and upon the flesh of man your wrath is exercised until the great day of judgment.</p>

<p class="v">5. "And now therefore, God, Lord and great King, I beseech you and ask you to hear my prayer: to leave me a posterity on the earth, and not to destroy all human flesh, and not to empty the earth, and that the destruction not be eternal.</p>

<p class="v">6. "And now therefore, O my Lord, exterminate from the earth the flesh that has provoked you to anger, but the flesh of righteousness and uprightness, make it a plant whose seed shall be eternal, and do not hide your face from the request of your servant, O Lord."</p>

### Chapter 85 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXV)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Second dream of Enoch. — History of the world.</p>

<p class="v">1. And after this I saw another dream, and I am going to show you this whole dream, O my son.</p>

<p class="v">2. Then Enoch lifted up (his voice) and said to his son Mathusala: I want to speak to you, my son; listen to my word, and lend your ear to the vision of your father's dream. 8. Before taking your mother Ednâ, I saw a vision upon my bed, and behold: a bull came out of the earth, and this bull was white. After him came out a heifer, and with her came out two calves, of which one was black and the other red.</p>

<p class="v">4. Now the black calf struck the red one and pursued it upon the earth, and from then on I could no longer see this red calf. 5. Then the black calf grew, and this heifer came with him, and I saw come out from him many bulls that resembled him and followed after him.</p>

<p class="v">6. And this heifer, the first one, went away from the first bull to seek the red calf, and she did not find it, and she raised a great lamentation over it, and she sought it. 7. And I saw until the first bull came, and he made her be silent, and from then on she cried out no more. 8. She then bore another white bull, and after him she bore many bulls and heifers of black color.</p>

<p class="v">9. And I saw in my sleep this white bull likewise grow and become a great white bull, and from him came out many white bulls that resembled him. 10. And they began to beget many white bulls that resembled them and followed one another.</p>

### Chapter 86 <span class="chap-roman">(LXXXVI)</span> {: .chap}

<p class="chap-sub">Continuation of the history of the world. — The stars and the bulls.</p>

<p class="v">1. And I saw again with my own eyes in my sleep, I saw the sky above, and behold: a star fell from the sky, and it rose up and ate, and it grazed in the midst of these bulls. 2. I then saw great bulls and black (bulls), and behold: they all exchanged their stalls and their pastures and their calves, and they began to live with one another.</p>

<p class="v">3. And I saw again in a vision, and I looked at the sky, and behold: I saw many stars come down and cast themselves down from the height of heaven near this first star, and in the midst of these calves they became bulls, and with them they grazed in the midst of them. 4. And I looked at them, and I saw, and behold: they all put forth their sexual member like horses and began to mount upon the heifers of the bulls, and they all conceived and they brought forth elephants, camels and asses. 5. And all the bulls feared them and were frightened of them; and they (the elephants, the camels and the asses) began to bite with their teeth and to devour and to strike with their horns. 6.
